1	# make_materials.py - Unreal Editor Python script that (re)builds the project's few materials from text.
2	#
3	# The .uasset files are not in git (Content/ is ignored except Content/Data), so this script IS the source of the
4	# materials. Run it through Tools/Jam/Make-Materials.ps1 (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript), Editor closed.
5	#
6	# M_PixelSurface (/Game/Glyphbound/Materials/M_PixelSurface): the look of every medieval / magic structure
7	# (GDD 3: "pixel-art environments are 3D geometry with low-resolution pixel textures"). Used from C++ by
8	# GBPlaceholder::SetupTexturedShape through a dynamic material instance. Parameters:
9	#   Texture   (texture object) the tile, a transient texture set at runtime (wrap addressing, nearest filter)
10	#   TileSize  (scalar, cm)     one tile covers TileSize x TileSize cm in the world, on every face
11	#   Tint      (vector)         multiplies the texture color
12	#   Glow      (scalar)         emissive = color * Glow (0 = plain lit surface)
13	#
14	# Why the projection is built by hand instead of using the engine function WorldAlignedTexture: the texture sample
15	# inside that function uses the shared sampler "Wrap, World group settings", which takes its filtering from the
16	# World texture group (smooth). Pixel art needs the texture's own nearest filter, so our sample uses
17	# "From texture asset" and the world-space projection is rebuilt here: absolute world position / TileSize, and the
18	# projection plane is picked by the dominant axis of the vertex normal (hard switch, no blending between planes).
19	
20	import unreal
21	
22	MATERIAL_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Materials"
23	PIXEL_SURFACE = "M_PixelSurface"
24	PIXEL_DECAL = "M_PixelDecal"
25	DEFAULT_TEXTURE = "/Engine/EngineMaterials/DefaultDiffuse.DefaultDiffuse"
26	
27	MEL = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary
28	
29	
30	def log(message):
31	    unreal.log("make_materials: " + message)
32	
33	
34	def fail(message):
35	    unreal.log_error("make_materials: ERROR " + message)
36	    raise RuntimeError(message)
37	
38	
39	def get_or_create_material(directory, name):
40	    path = directory + "/" + name
41	    if unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_asset_exist(path):
42	        material = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.load_asset(path)
43	        if not isinstance(material, unreal.Material):
44	            fail("%s exists but is not a Material" % path)
45	        # Rebuild the graph from scratch so the asset always matches this script.
46	        MEL.delete_all_material_expressions(material)
47	        log("rebuilding %s" % path)
48	        return material
49	    if not unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_directory_exist(directory):
50	        unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.make_directory(directory)
51	    tools = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()
52	    material = tools.create_asset(name, directory, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())
53	    if material is None:
54	        fail("could not create %s" % path)
55	    log("created %s" % path)
56	    return material
57	
58	
59	class Graph(object):
60	    def __init__(self, material):
61	        self.material = material
62	        self.x = -1600
63	
64	    def node(self, expression_class, x, y, **properties):
65	        expression = MEL.create_material_expression(self.material, expression_class, x, y)
66	        if expression is None:
67	            fail("could not create %s" % expression_class.__name__)
68	        for key, value in properties.items():
69	            expression.set_editor_property(key, value)
70	        return expression
71	
72	    def connect(self, source, source_output, target, target_inputs):
73	        """target_inputs: one input name or a list of accepted names (script name first, full name second)."""
74	        if isinstance(target_inputs, str):
75	            target_inputs = [target_inputs]
76	        for target_input in target_inputs:
77	            if MEL.connect_material_expressions(source, source_output, target, target_input):
78	                return
79	        fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s.%r (outputs %s, inputs %s)" % (
80	            source.get_class().get_name(), source_output, target.get_class().get_name(), target_inputs,
81	            list(MEL.get_material_expression_output_names(source)),
82	            list(MEL.get_material_expression_input_names(target))))
83	
84	    def to_property(self, source, source_output, material_property):
85	        if not MEL.connect_material_property(source, source_output, material_property):
86	            fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s (outputs %s)" % (
87	                source.get_class().get_name(), source_output, material_property,
88	                list(MEL.get_material_expression_output_names(source))))
89	
90	
91	def mask(graph, source, x, y, r=False, g=False, b=False, a=False):
92	    expression = graph.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, x, y, r=r, g=g, b=b, a=a)
93	    graph.connect(source, "", expression, ["", "Input"])
94	    return expression
95	
96	
97	def build_pixel_surface():
98	    material = get_or_create_material(MATERIAL_DIR, PIXEL_SURFACE)
99	    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_OPAQUE)
100	    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
101	    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)
102	
103	    default_texture = unreal.load_asset(DEFAULT_TEXTURE)
104	    if default_texture is None:
105	        fail("cannot load the default texture %s" % DEFAULT_TEXTURE)
106	
107	    g = Graph(material)
108	
109	    # ---- Parameters ----
110	    texture = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureObjectParameter, -1400, -500,
111	                     parameter_name="Texture", texture=default_texture,
112	                     sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
113	    tile_size = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, -2000, 0,
114	                       parameter_name="TileSize", default_value=100.0)
115	    tint = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, -600, -250,
116	                  parameter_name="Tint", default_value=unreal.LinearColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
117	    glow = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, -400, 150,
118	                  parameter_name="Glow", default_value=0.0)
119	
120	    # ---- World-space coordinates in tiles ----
121	    world_position = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionWorldPosition, -2000, -150)
122	    in_tiles = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionDivide, -1800, -100)
123	    g.connect(world_position, "", in_tiles, "A")
124	    g.connect(tile_size, "", in_tiles, "B")
125	
126	    wx = mask(g, in_tiles, -1650, -250, r=True)
127	    wy = mask(g, in_tiles, -1650, -150, g=True)
128	    wz = mask(g, in_tiles, -1650, -50, b=True)
129	    # Texture rows go top to bottom: V = -Z keeps the sprite upright on walls.
130	    wz_down = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -1500, -50, const_b=-1.0)
131	    g.connect(wz, "", wz_down, "A")
132	
133	    uv_x = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAppendVector, -1300, -250)  # faces looking along X
134	    g.connect(wy, "", uv_x, "A")
135	    g.connect(wz_down, "", uv_x, "B")
136	    uv_y = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAppendVector, -1300, -150)  # faces looking along Y
137	    g.connect(wx, "", uv_y, "A")
138	    g.connect(wz_down, "", uv_y, "B")
139	    uv_z = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAppendVector, -1300, -50)   # floors and ceilings
140	    g.connect(wx, "", uv_z, "A")
141	    g.connect(wy, "", uv_z, "B")
142	
143	    # ---- Pick the plane by the dominant axis of the normal ----
144	    normal = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVertexNormalWS, -2000, 250)
145	    normal_abs = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAbs, -1800, 250)
146	    g.connect(normal, "", normal_abs, ["", "Input"])
147	    nx = mask(g, normal_abs, -1650, 200, r=True)
148	    ny = mask(g, normal_abs, -1650, 300, g=True)
149	    nz = mask(g, normal_abs, -1650, 400, b=True)
150	
151	    uv_side = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, -1100, -150)
152	    g.connect(nx, "", uv_side, "A")
153	    g.connect(ny, "", uv_side, "B")
154	    g.connect(uv_x, "", uv_side, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
155	    g.connect(uv_y, "", uv_side, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
156	    g.connect(uv_y, "", uv_side, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])
157	
158	    side_max = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMax, -1300, 300)
159	    g.connect(nx, "", side_max, "A")
160	    g.connect(ny, "", side_max, "B")
161	
162	    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, -900, -100)
163	    g.connect(nz, "", uv, "A")
164	    g.connect(side_max, "", uv, "B")
165	    g.connect(uv_z, "", uv, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
166	    g.connect(uv_side, "", uv, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
167	    g.connect(uv_side, "", uv, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])
168	
169	    # ---- Sample with the texture's own filter and addressing (nearest + wrap for tiles) ----
170	    sample = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, -700, -300,
171	                    sampler_source=unreal.SamplerSourceMode.SSM_FROM_TEXTURE_ASSET,
172	                    sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
173	    g.connect(texture, "", sample, ["Tex", "TextureObject"])
174	    g.connect(uv, "", sample, ["UVs", "Coordinates"])
175	
176	    tint_rgb = mask(g, tint, -450, -250, r=True, g=True, b=True)
177	    color = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -300, -300)
178	    g.connect(sample, "RGB", color, "A")
179	    g.connect(tint_rgb, "", color, "B")
180	
181	    emissive = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -150, 0)
182	    g.connect(color, "", emissive, "A")
183	    g.connect(glow, "", emissive, "B")
184	
185	    roughness = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -150, 150, r=0.9)
186	
187	    g.to_property(color, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
188	    g.to_property(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
189	    g.to_property(roughness, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
190	
191	    check_and_save(material, PIXEL_SURFACE)
192	
193	def check_and_save(material, name):
194	    errors = MEL.recompile_material(material)
195	    if errors:
196	        for error in errors:
197	            unreal.log_error("make_materials: ERROR compile: %s" % error)
198	        fail("%s has compile errors" % name)
199	    bad_nodes = MEL.get_material_error_expressions(material)
200	    if bad_nodes:
201	        fail("%s: %d expressions report errors: %s" % (
202	            name, len(bad_nodes), [n.get_class().get_name() for n in bad_nodes]))
203	
204	    path = MATERIAL_DIR + "/" + name
205	    if not unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_asset(path, only_if_is_dirty=False):
206	        fail("could not save %s" % path)
207	    log("saved %s (params: %s %s %s)" % (
208	        path,
209	        list(MEL.get_texture_parameter_names(material)) if hasattr(MEL, "get_texture_parameter_names") else "",
210	        list(MEL.get_scalar_parameter_names(material)) if hasattr(MEL, "get_scalar_parameter_names") else "",
211	        list(MEL.get_vector_parameter_names(material)) if hasattr(MEL, "get_vector_parameter_names") else ""))
212	
213	
214	def build_pixel_decal():
215	    # Ground spell figures (GDD 3 and 18): one flat quad on the floor with the spell's sprite stretched
216	    # once over it. Masked (cutout) so transparent pixels show the floor; mesh UVs (TexCoord 0), not
217	    # world position; the texture's own nearest sampler (same reason as M_PixelSurface: the shared
218	    # world-group sampler would smooth the pixels).
219	    material = get_or_create_material(MATERIAL_DIR, PIXEL_DECAL)
220	    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_MASKED)
221	    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
222	    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", True)
223	    material.set_editor_property("opacity_mask_clip_value", 0.5)
224	
225	    default_texture = unreal.load_asset(DEFAULT_TEXTURE)
226	    if default_texture is None:
227	        fail("cannot load the default texture %s" % DEFAULT_TEXTURE)
228	
229	    g = Graph(material)
230	
231	    # ---- Parameters (same names as M_PixelSurface where they mean the same) ----
232	    texture = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureObjectParameter, -1400, -500,
233	                     parameter_name="Texture", texture=default_texture,
234	                     sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
235	    tint = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, -600, -250,
236	                  parameter_name="Tint", default_value=unreal.LinearColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
237	    glow = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, -400, 150,
238	                  parameter_name="Glow", default_value=0.0)
239	
240	    # ---- Mesh UVs: the whole texture stretched once over the quad ----
241	    texcoord = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -1300, -100,
242	                      coordinate_index=0)
243	
244	    # ---- Sample with the texture's own filter (nearest, no smoothing) ----
245	    sample = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, -700, -300,
246	                    sampler_source=unreal.SamplerSourceMode.SSM_FROM_TEXTURE_ASSET,
247	                    sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
248	    g.connect(texture, "", sample, ["Tex", "TextureObject"])
249	    g.connect(texcoord, "", sample, ["UVs", "Coordinates"])
250	
251	    tint_rgb = mask(g, tint, -450, -250, r=True, g=True, b=True)
252	    color = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -300, -300)
253	    g.connect(sample, "RGB", color, "A")
254	    g.connect(tint_rgb, "", color, "B")
255	
256	    emissive = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -150, 0)
257	    g.connect(color, "", emissive, "A")
258	    g.connect(glow, "", emissive, "B")
259	
260	    roughness = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -150, 150, r=0.9)
261	
262	    g.to_property(color, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
263	    g.to_property(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
264	    g.to_property(roughness, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
265	    g.to_property(sample, "A", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_OPACITY_MASK)
266	
267	    check_and_save(material, PIXEL_DECAL)
268	
269	
270	def main():
271	    build_pixel_surface()
272	    build_pixel_decal()
273	    log("OK")
274	
275

# make_materials.py - Unreal Editor Python script that (re)builds the project's few materials from text.
#
# The .uasset files are not in git (Content/ is ignored except Content/Data), so this script IS the source of the
# materials. Run it through Tools/Jam/Make-Materials.ps1 (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript), Editor closed.
#
# M_PixelSurface (/Game/Glyphbound/Materials/M_PixelSurface): the look of every medieval / magic structure
# (GDD 3: "pixel-art environments are 3D geometry with low-resolution pixel textures"). Used from C++ by
# GBPlaceholder::SetupTexturedShape through a dynamic material instance. Parameters:
#   Texture   (texture object) the tile, a transient texture set at runtime (wrap addressing, nearest filter)
#   TileSize  (scalar, cm)     one tile covers TileSize x TileSize cm in the world, on every face
#   Tint      (vector)         multiplies the texture color
#   Glow      (scalar)         emissive = color * Glow (0 = plain lit surface)
#
# Why the projection is built by hand instead of using the engine function WorldAlignedTexture: the texture sample
# inside that function uses the shared sampler "Wrap, World group settings", which takes its filtering from the
# World texture group (smooth). Pixel art needs the texture's own nearest filter, so our sample uses
# "From texture asset" and the world-space projection is rebuilt here: absolute world position / TileSize, and the
# projection plane is picked by the dominant axis of the vertex normal (hard switch, no blending between planes).

import unreal

MATERIAL_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Materials"
PIXEL_SURFACE = "M_PixelSurface"
PIXEL_DECAL = "M_PixelDecal"
DEFAULT_TEXTURE = "/Engine/EngineMaterials/DefaultDiffuse.DefaultDiffuse"

MEL = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary


def log(message):
    unreal.log("make_materials: " + message)


def fail(message):
    unreal.log_error("make_materials: ERROR " + message)
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def get_or_create_material(directory, name):
    path = directory + "/" + name
    if unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_asset_exist(path):
        material = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.load_asset(path)
        if not isinstance(material, unreal.Material):
            fail("%s exists but is not a Material" % path)
        # Rebuild the graph from scratch so the asset always matches this script.
        MEL.delete_all_material_expressions(material)
        log("rebuilding %s" % path)
        return material
    if not unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_directory_exist(directory):
        unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.make_directory(directory)
    tools = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()
    material = tools.create_asset(name, directory, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())
    if material is None:
        fail("could not create %s" % path)
    log("created %s" % path)
    return material


class Graph(object):
    def __init__(self, material):
        self.material = material
        self.x = -1600

    def node(self, expression_class, x, y, **properties):
        expression = MEL.create_material_expression(self.material, expression_class, x, y)
        if expression is None:
            fail("could not create %s" % expression_class.__name__)
        for key, value in properties.items():
            expression.set_editor_property(key, value)
        return expression

    def connect(self, source, source_output, target, target_inputs):
        """target_inputs: one input name or a list of accepted names (script name first, full name second)."""
        if isinstance(target_inputs, str):
            target_inputs = [target_inputs]
        for target_input in target_inputs:
            if MEL.connect_material_expressions(source, source_output, target, target_input):
                return
        fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s.%r (outputs %s, inputs %s)" % (
            source.get_class().get_name(), source_output, target.get_class().get_name(), target_inputs,
            list(MEL.get_material_expression_output_names(source)),
            list(MEL.get_material_expression_input_names(target))))

    def to_property(self, source, source_output, material_property):
        if not MEL.connect_material_property(source, source_output, material_property):
            fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s (outputs %s)" % (
                source.get_class().get_name(), source_output, material_property,
                list(MEL.get_material_expression_output_names(source))))


def mask(graph, source, x, y, r=False, g=False, b=False, a=False):
    expression = graph.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, x, y, r=r, g=g, b=b, a=a)
    graph.connect(source, "", expression, ["", "Input"])
    return expression


def build_pixel_surface():
    material = get_or_create_material(MATERIAL_DIR, PIXEL_SURFACE)
    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_OPAQUE)
    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)

    default_texture = unreal.load_asset(DEFAULT_TEXTURE)
    if default_texture is None:
        fail("cannot load the default texture %s" % DEFAULT_TEXTURE)

    g = Graph(material)

    # ---- Parameters ----
    texture = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureObjectParameter, -1400, -500,
                     parameter_name="Texture", texture=default_texture,
                     sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
    tile_size = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, -2000, 0,
                       parameter_name="TileSize", default_value=100.0)
    tint = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, -600, -250,
                  parameter_name="Tint", default_value=unreal.LinearColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
    glow = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, -400, 150,
                  parameter_name="Glow", default_value=0.0)

    # ---- World-space coordinates in tiles ----
    world_position = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionWorldPosition, -2000, -150)
    in_tiles = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionDivide, -1800, -100)
    g.connect(world_position, "", in_tiles, "A")
    g.connect(tile_size, "", in_tiles, "B")

    wx = mask(g, in_tiles, -1650, -250, r=True)
    wy = mask(g, in_tiles, -1650, -150, g=True)
    wz = mask(g, in_tiles, -1650, -50, b=True)
    # Texture rows go top to bottom: V = -Z keeps the sprite upright on walls.
    wz_down = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -1500, -50, const_b=-1.0)
    g.connect(wz, "", wz_down, "A")

    uv_x = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAppendVector, -1300, -250)  # faces looking along X
    g.connect(wy, "", uv_x, "A")
    g.connect(wz_down, "", uv_x, "B")
    uv_y = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAppendVector, -1300, -150)  # faces looking along Y
    g.connect(wx, "", uv_y, "A")
    g.connect(wz_down, "", uv_y, "B")
    uv_z = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAppendVector, -1300, -50)   # floors and ceilings
    g.connect(wx, "", uv_z, "A")
    g.connect(wy, "", uv_z, "B")

    # ---- Pick the plane by the dominant axis of the normal ----
    normal = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVertexNormalWS, -2000, 250)
    normal_abs = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAbs, -1800, 250)
    g.connect(normal, "", normal_abs, ["", "Input"])
    nx = mask(g, normal_abs, -1650, 200, r=True)
    ny = mask(g, normal_abs, -1650, 300, g=True)
    nz = mask(g, normal_abs, -1650, 400, b=True)

    uv_side = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, -1100, -150)
    g.connect(nx, "", uv_side, "A")
    g.connect(ny, "", uv_side, "B")
    g.connect(uv_x, "", uv_side, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
    g.connect(uv_y, "", uv_side, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
    g.connect(uv_y, "", uv_side, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])

    side_max = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMax, -1300, 300)
    g.connect(nx, "", side_max, "A")
    g.connect(ny, "", side_max, "B")

    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, -900, -100)
    g.connect(nz, "", uv, "A")
    g.connect(side_max, "", uv, "B")
    g.connect(uv_z, "", uv, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
    g.connect(uv_side, "", uv, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
    g.connect(uv_side, "", uv, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])

    # ---- Sample with the texture's own filter and addressing (nearest + wrap for tiles) ----
    sample = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, -700, -300,
                    sampler_source=unreal.SamplerSourceMode.SSM_FROM_TEXTURE_ASSET,
                    sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
    g.connect(texture, "", sample, ["Tex", "TextureObject"])
    g.connect(uv, "", sample, ["UVs", "Coordinates"])

    tint_rgb = mask(g, tint, -450, -250, r=True, g=True, b=True)
    color = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -300, -300)
    g.connect(sample, "RGB", color, "A")
    g.connect(tint_rgb, "", color, "B")

    emissive = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -150, 0)
    g.connect(color, "", emissive, "A")
    g.connect(glow, "", emissive, "B")

    roughness = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -150, 150, r=0.9)

    g.to_property(color, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.to_property(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    g.to_property(roughness, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)

    check_and_save(material, PIXEL_SURFACE)

def check_and_save(material, name):
    errors = MEL.recompile_material(material)
    if errors:
        for error in errors:
            unreal.log_error("make_materials: ERROR compile: %s" % error)
        fail("%s has compile errors" % name)
    bad_nodes = MEL.get_material_error_expressions(material)
    if bad_nodes:
        fail("%s: %d expressions report errors: %s" % (
            name, len(bad_nodes), [n.get_class().get_name() for n in bad_nodes]))

    path = MATERIAL_DIR + "/" + name
    if not unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_asset(path, only_if_is_dirty=False):
        fail("could not save %s" % path)
    log("saved %s (params: %s %s %s)" % (
        path,
        list(MEL.get_texture_parameter_names(material)) if hasattr(MEL, "get_texture_parameter_names") else "",
        list(MEL.get_scalar_parameter_names(material)) if hasattr(MEL, "get_scalar_parameter_names") else "",
        list(MEL.get_vector_parameter_names(material)) if hasattr(MEL, "get_vector_parameter_names") else ""))


def build_pixel_decal():
    # Ground spell figures (GDD 3 and 18): one flat quad on the floor with the spell's sprite stretched
    # once over it. Masked (cutout) so transparent pixels show the floor; mesh UVs (TexCoord 0), not
    # world position; the texture's own nearest sampler (same reason as M_PixelSurface: the shared
    # world-group sampler would smooth the pixels).
    material = get_or_create_material(MATERIAL_DIR, PIXEL_DECAL)
    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_MASKED)
    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", True)
    material.set_editor_property("opacity_mask_clip_value", 0.5)

    default_texture = unreal.load_asset(DEFAULT_TEXTURE)
    if default_texture is None:
        fail("cannot load the default texture %s" % DEFAULT_TEXTURE)

    g = Graph(material)

    # ---- Parameters (same names as M_PixelSurface where they mean the same) ----
    texture = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureObjectParameter, -1400, -500,
                     parameter_name="Texture", texture=default_texture,
                     sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
    tint = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, -600, -250,
                  parameter_name="Tint", default_value=unreal.LinearColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
    glow = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, -400, 150,
                  parameter_name="Glow", default_value=0.0)

    # ---- Mesh UVs: the whole texture stretched once over the quad ----
    texcoord = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -1300, -100,
                      coordinate_index=0)

    # ---- Sample with the texture's own filter (nearest, no smoothing) ----
    sample = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, -700, -300,
                    sampler_source=unreal.SamplerSourceMode.SSM_FROM_TEXTURE_ASSET,
                    sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
    g.connect(texture, "", sample, ["Tex", "TextureObject"])
    g.connect(texcoord, "", sample, ["UVs", "Coordinates"])

    tint_rgb = mask(g, tint, -450, -250, r=True, g=True, b=True)
    color = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -300, -300)
    g.connect(sample, "RGB", color, "A")
    g.connect(tint_rgb, "", color, "B")

    emissive = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -150, 0)
    g.connect(color, "", emissive, "A")
    g.connect(glow, "", emissive, "B")

    roughness = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -150, 150, r=0.9)

    g.to_property(color, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.to_property(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    g.to_property(roughness, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    g.to_property(sample, "A", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_OPACITY_MASK)

    check_and_save(material, PIXEL_DECAL)


def main():
    build_pixel_surface()
    build_pixel_decal()
    log("OK")


main()

# Lists the objects of the pistol .blend: type, parent, transform, size, materials, UV maps and animation.
# Usage: blender -b <Pistol.blend> --python pistol_list_objects.py
import bpy

scene = bpy.context.scene
print("FRAMES", scene.frame_start, scene.frame_end, "unit scale", scene.unit_settings.scale_length)
for ob in bpy.data.objects:
    act = ob.animation_data.action.name if ob.animation_data and ob.animation_data.action else None
    mats = [s.material.name for s in ob.material_slots if s.material] if ob.type == "MESH" else []
    uvs = [l.name for l in ob.data.uv_layers] if ob.type == "MESH" else []
    tris = sum(len(p.vertices) - 2 for p in ob.data.polygons) if ob.type == "MESH" else 0
    cons = [c.type for c in ob.constraints]
    print("OBJ", ob.name, ob.type, "parent=", ob.parent.name if ob.parent else None,
          "ptype=", ob.parent_type, "loc=", tuple(round(v, 4) for v in ob.location),
          "rot=", tuple(round(v, 4) for v in ob.rotation_euler), "scale=", tuple(round(v, 4) for v in ob.scale),
          "dims=", tuple(round(v, 4) for v in ob.dimensions), "tris=", tris, "mats=", mats, "uvs=", uvs,
          "action=", act, "cons=", cons, "mods=", [m.type for m in ob.modifiers], "hidden=", ob.hide_render)
for a in bpy.data.actions:
    print("ACTION", a.name, "range", tuple(a.frame_range))
    try:
        curves = a.fcurves
    except AttributeError:
        curves = [fc for layer in a.layers for strip in layer.strips for bag in strip.channelbags for fc in bag.fcurves]
    for fc in curves:
        kps = [(round(k.co[0], 1), round(k.co[1], 4)) for k in fc.keyframe_points]
        print("  FC", fc.data_path, fc.array_index, kps[:12])
for m in bpy.data.materials:
    print("MAT", m.name, "users", m.users)

# Exports the pistol as four static-mesh FBX files for Unreal (the game animates the moving parts in code):
#   SM_Pistol_Body      everything that does not move (optic pane, reticle, panels, vents, rails included)
#   SM_Pistol_Trigger   pivot = Trigger_pivot_trial (Blender pulls it -8 deg around Y at frame 8)
#   SM_Pistol_Magazine  pivot = TRIAL_Magazine_Control (Blender slides it out and back, frames 24-72)
#   SM_Pistol_EnergyBar V4_energy_cells alone, so its second UV map (ImbueU) reaches UE as UV channel 1
# Every part is taken at frame 1 (rest pose), in world space, then moved so that:
#   - the hand point HAND (top of the grip, under the slide) is the origin of the body,
#   - each moving part has its pivot at its own origin,
#   - the gun is turned 180 deg around Z so the muzzle points to +X (Unreal forward) and the energy bar side
#     (Blender -Y) ends on +Y in Blender, which the FBX importer mirrors to -Y in Unreal (the side the camera sees).
# Faces with Optic_OriginalLens_Invisible (the old lens, transparent in Blender) are dropped.
# Units: Blender metres, real size (0.97 m long); the game scales the viewmodel.
# Usage: blender -b Pistol.blend --python pistol_export_fbx.py -- <out_dir>
import bpy, bmesh, sys, os, json
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector

argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
out_dir = argv[0]
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.frame_set(1)

TRIGGER = ["Trigger_Complete_Moving"]
MAGAZINE = ["TRIAL_Magazine_Body", "TRIAL_Magazine_Base"]
ENERGY = ["V4_energy_cells"]
DROP_MATERIALS = {"Optic_OriginalLens_Invisible"}
moving = set(TRIGGER + MAGAZINE + ENERGY)
BODY = [o.name for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == "MESH" and o.name not in moving]

# Hand point: X of the magazine pivot (the grip axis at the top), Z of the trigger pivot (under the slide).
mag_pivot = bpy.data.objects["TRIAL_Magazine_Control"].matrix_world.translation.copy()
trig_pivot = bpy.data.objects["Trigger_pivot_trial"].matrix_world.translation.copy()
HAND = Vector((mag_pivot.x, 0.0, trig_pivot.z))
TURN = Matrix.Rotation(3.141592653589793, 4, "Z")


def build(name, sources, pivot):
    """One new mesh object = the sources in world space, with pivot at the origin, turned to face +X."""
    bm = bmesh.new()
    materials = []
    depsgraph = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    for src_name in sources:
        src = bpy.data.objects[src_name]
        ev = src.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
        me = ev.to_mesh()
        me.transform(src.matrix_world)
        # map this object's material slots to the joined list
        remap = []
        for slot in src.material_slots:
            mat = slot.material
            if mat is None or mat.name in DROP_MATERIALS:
                remap.append(-1)
                continue
            if mat not in materials:
                materials.append(mat)
            remap.append(materials.index(mat))
        tmp = bmesh.new()
        tmp.from_mesh(me)
        ev.to_mesh_clear()
        drop = [f for f in tmp.faces if remap and remap[f.material_index] < 0]
        bmesh.ops.delete(tmp, geom=drop, context="FACES")
        for f in tmp.faces:
            f.material_index = remap[f.material_index] if remap else 0
        tmp_me = bpy.data.meshes.new("tmp")
        tmp.to_mesh(tmp_me)
        tmp.free()
        bm.from_mesh(tmp_me)
        bpy.data.meshes.remove(tmp_me)
    bm.transform(TURN @ Matrix.Translation(-pivot))
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    for mat in materials:
        me.materials.append(mat)
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    xs = [v.co.x for v in me.vertices]; ys = [v.co.y for v in me.vertices]; zs = [v.co.z for v in me.vertices]
    info = {"tris": sum(len(p.vertices) - 2 for p in me.polygons),
            "min": [round(min(xs), 4), round(min(ys), 4), round(min(zs), 4)],
            "max": [round(max(xs), 4), round(max(ys), 4), round(max(zs), 4)],
            "materials": [m.name for m in materials], "uv_maps": [l.name for l in me.uv_layers]}
    print("PART", name, json.dumps(info))
    return ob, info

    for o in bpy.context.view_layer.objects:
        o.select_set(False)
    ob.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = ob
    path = os.path.join(out_dir, ob.name + ".fbx")
    bpy.ops.export_scene.fbx(filepath=path, use_selection=True, object_types={"MESH"}, apply_unit_scale=True,
                             apply_scale_options="FBX_SCALE_NONE", mesh_smooth_type="FACE", use_mesh_modifiers=False,
                             add_leaf_bones=False, bake_anim=False, use_custom_props=False, path_mode="STRIP",
                             axis_forward="-Z", axis_up="Y")
    print("WROTE", path)


report = {"hand_point_blender": [round(v, 4) for v in HAND], "parts": {}}
for name, sources, pivot in [("SM_Pistol_Body", BODY, HAND),
                             ("SM_Pistol_Trigger", TRIGGER, trig_pivot),
                             ("SM_Pistol_Magazine", MAGAZINE, mag_pivot),
                             ("SM_Pistol_EnergyBar", ENERGY, HAND)]:
    ob, info = build(name, sources, pivot)
    # where the part's origin sits relative to the body origin, in the exported (turned) frame, metres
    offset = TURN @ (pivot - HAND)

    report["parts"][name] = info
    export(ob)

# Motion of the moving parts, in the exported frame (metres / degrees), from the Blender keys.
mag_out = Vector((0.4465, 0.0, -0.4661))  # TRIAL_Magazine_Control location at frames 40-56
report["magazine_out_offset"] = [round(v, 4) for v in (TURN.to_3x3() @ (mag_out - mag_pivot))]
report["trigger_pull_deg_about_blender_y"] = -8.0
with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "export_report.json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
print("REPORT", json.dumps(report))

# import_pistol.py - Unreal Editor Python script that imports the cyberpunk pistol from SourceArt and builds its
# materials. Content/ is not in git, so this script plus the source files on CENTRAL are the source of the assets.
# Run it through Tools/Jam/Import-Pistol.ps1 (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript), Editor closed.
#
# Inputs (CENTRAL only, outside git): Glyphbound/SourceArt/Weapons/Pistol/
#   Export/SM_Pistol_{Body,Trigger,Magazine,EnergyBar}.fbx  (Tools/Blender/pistol_export_fbx.py)
#   Textures/T_Pistol_{BaseColor,ORM,Normal,EmissiveMask}.png (Tools/Blender/pistol_prepare_ue.py)
# Output: /Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol/ (meshes, textures, materials, instances). Parameters the game sets
# (keep in sync with AGBGun, Source/Glyphbound/Weapons/GBGun.cpp):
#   ElementColor   (vector) the glow colour: the enchant element, or the gun's own colour when not enchanted
#   ImbueRemaining (scalar) M_GunEnergy only: cells with ImbueU < ImbueRemaining light up (0 = bar dark, 1 = full)
# Every material slot of every mesh must get a material from SLOT_MATERIALS, or the script fails.

import os
import re
import unreal

MESH_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol"
SOURCE_DIR = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(unreal.Paths.project_dir(), "SourceArt", "Weapons", "Pistol"))
MESHES = ["SM_Pistol_Body", "SM_Pistol_Trigger", "SM_Pistol_Magazine", "SM_Pistol_EnergyBar"]
TEXTURES = {
    # name: (compression, sRGB)
    "T_Pistol_BaseColor": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_DEFAULT, True),
    "T_Pistol_ORM": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
    "T_Pistol_Normal": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_NORMALMAP, False),
    "T_Pistol_EmissiveMask": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
}
GUN_GREEN = unreal.LinearColor(0.02, 1.0, 0.07, 1.0)

# Blender material -> (parent material, {param: value}). Values copied from the Principled BSDF of each material
# (Tools/Blender/pistol_list_materials.py). Glow = Blender emission strength (emission colour = element colour).
SOLID = "M_GunSolid"
SLOT_MATERIALS = {
    "tripo_material": ("M_PistolAtlas", {}),
    "Refinished_gunmetal_panels": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.83, 0.85, 0.88), "Metallic": 0.55, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "Refined_dark_receiver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.055, 0.061, 0.07), "Metallic": 0.78, "Roughness": 0.32}),
    "FPS_SightHousing_Black": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.027, 0.031, 0.039), "Metallic": 0.7, "Roughness": 0.36}),
    "Optic_Frame_Machined_Black": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.025, 0.03, 0.038), "Metallic": 0.7, "Roughness": 0.3}),
    "Optic_Tinted_Transparent": ("M_GunGlass", {}),
    "Optic_Reticle_Element": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.01, 0.01, 0.01), "Metallic": 0.0, "Roughness": 0.5, "Glow": 2.0}),
    "Panel_Finish_Bezel": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.012, 0.016), "Metallic": 0.75, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "Panel_Finish_Element": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.014, 0.02, 0.02), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.23, "Glow": 0.04}),
    "Panel_Finish_Graphics": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.012, 0.012), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.3, "Glow": 1.0}),
    "Trial_Magazine_DarkMetal": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.04, 0.046, 0.055), "Metallic": 0.75, "Roughness": 0.3}),
    "Trial_Magazine_Silver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.43, 0.46, 0.49), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "V4_dark_metal": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.027, 0.03, 0.038), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.35}),
    "V4_satin_edge": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.1, 0.105, 0.12), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.3}),
    "Refined_vent_recess": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.01, 0.014), "Metallic": 0.45, "Roughness": 0.42}),
    "Refined_satin_silver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.63, 0.66, 0.69), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "V4_element_emission": ("M_GunEnergy", {}),
}

MEL = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary
EAL = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary


def log(message):
    unreal.log("import_pistol: " + message)


def fail(message):
    unreal.log_error("import_pistol: ERROR " + message)
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def key(name):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower())


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- import

def run_import(filename, options=None):
    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()
    task.filename = filename
    task.destination_path = MESH_DIR
    task.automated = True
    task.replace_existing = True
    task.save = False
    if options is not None:
        task.options = options
    unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks([task])
    paths = list(task.imported_object_paths)
    if not paths:
        fail("nothing imported from %s" % filename)
    return paths


def import_textures():
    textures = {}
    for name, (compression, srgb) in TEXTURES.items():
        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Textures", name + ".png")
        if not os.path.isfile(source):
            fail("missing %s" % source)
        run_import(source)
        texture = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
        if not isinstance(texture, unreal.Texture2D):
            fail("%s did not import as a Texture2D" % name)
        texture.set_editor_property("compression_settings", compression)
        texture.set_editor_property("srgb", srgb)
        texture.set_editor_property("lod_group", unreal.TextureGroup.TEXTUREGROUP_WEAPON)
        textures[name] = texture
        log("texture %s %s srgb=%s" % (name, compression, srgb))
    return textures


def fbx_options():
    ui = unreal.FbxImportUI()
    ui.set_editor_property("import_mesh", True)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_as_skeletal", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_materials", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_textures", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_animations", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("mesh_type_to_import", unreal.FBXImportType.FBXIT_STATIC_MESH)
    data = ui.static_mesh_import_data
    data.set_editor_property("combine_meshes", True)
    data.set_editor_property("auto_generate_collision", False)
    data.set_editor_property("generate_lightmap_u_vs", False)
    data.set_editor_property("remove_degenerates", False)
    data.set_editor_property("convert_scene", True)
    data.set_editor_property("force_front_x_axis", False)
    data.set_editor_property("import_uniform_scale", 1.0)
    data.set_editor_property("normal_import_method", unreal.FBXNormalImportMethod.FBXNIM_IMPORT_NORMALS)
    return ui


def import_meshes():
    # The legacy FBX importer honours FbxImportUI; with Interchange on, these options would be translated.
    unreal.SystemLibrary.execute_console_command(None, "Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.FBX false")
    meshes = {}
    for name in MESHES:
        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Export", name + ".fbx")
        if not os.path.isfile(source):
            fail("missing %s (run Tools/Blender/pistol_export_fbx.py)" % source)
        run_import(source, fbx_options())
        mesh = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
        if not isinstance(mesh, unreal.StaticMesh):
            fail("%s did not import as a StaticMesh" % name)
        meshes[name] = mesh
    return meshes


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- materials

def get_or_create_material(name):
    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
        material = EAL.load_asset(path)
        if not isinstance(material, unreal.Material):
            fail("%s exists but is not a Material" % path)
        MEL.delete_all_material_expressions(material)
        return material
    material = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
        name, MESH_DIR, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())
    if material is None:
        fail("could not create %s" % path)
    return material


class Graph(object):
    def __init__(self, material):
        self.material = material

    def node(self, cls, x, y, **props):
        e = MEL.create_material_expression(self.material, cls, x, y)
        if e is None:
            fail("could not create %s" % cls.__name__)
        for k, v in props.items():
            e.set_editor_property(k, v)
        return e

    def connect(self, src, out, dst, inputs):
        if isinstance(inputs, str):
            inputs = [inputs]
        for i in inputs:
            if MEL.connect_material_expressions(src, out, dst, i):
                return
        fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s.%r (inputs %s)" % (
            src.get_class().get_name(), out, dst.get_class().get_name(), inputs,
            list(MEL.get_material_expression_input_names(dst))))

    def out(self, src, out, prop):
        if not MEL.connect_material_property(src, out, prop):
            fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s" % (src.get_class().get_name(), out, prop))

    def vector(self, name, x, y, value):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name,
                         default_value=unreal.LinearColor(value[0], value[1], value[2], 1.0))

    def scalar(self, name, x, y, value):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name, default_value=value)

    def mul(self, a, b, x, y):
        m = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, x, y)
        self.connect(a, "", m, "A")
        self.connect(b, "", m, "B")
        return m

    def rgb(self, src, x, y):
        m = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, x, y, r=True, g=True, b=True, a=False)
        self.connect(src, "", m, ["", "Input"])
        return m


def finish(material, name):
    errors = MEL.recompile_material(material)
    if errors:
        for e in errors:
            unreal.log_error("import_pistol: ERROR compile: %s" % e)
        fail("%s has compile errors" % name)
    bad = MEL.get_material_error_expressions(material)
    if bad:
        fail("%s: %d expressions report errors" % (name, len(bad)))
    log("material %s" % name)


def opaque(material):
    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_OPAQUE)
    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)


def element_glow(g, x, y, glow_default):
    """ElementColor * Glow -> the emissive of a part that glows in the element colour."""
    color = g.rgb(g.vector("ElementColor", x, y, (GUN_GREEN.r, GUN_GREEN.g, GUN_GREEN.b)), x + 200, y)
    return g.mul(color, g.scalar("Glow", x, y + 150, glow_default), x + 400, y + 50)


def build_solid():
    # Plain PBR values per slot (instances set them) + optional glow in the element colour.
    m = get_or_create_material(SOLID)
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    g.out(g.rgb(g.vector("BaseColor", -800, -300, (0.05, 0.05, 0.06)), -600, -300), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.scalar("Metallic", -800, -150, 0.75), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(g.scalar("Roughness", -800, -50, 0.3), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    g.out(element_glow(g, -1000, 100, 0.0), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, SOLID)
    return m


def texture_sample(g, texture, sampler, x, y):
    return g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, x, y, texture=texture, sampler_type=sampler)


def build_atlas(textures):
    # The cleaned Tripo atlas: albedo, ORM (R AO, G roughness, B metallic), DirectX normal, and the glow mask
    # (Blender: emission strength 0.65 where the mask is set, in the element colour).
    m = get_or_create_material("M_PistolAtlas")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    base = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_BaseColor"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR, -900, -500)
    orm = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_ORM"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS, -900, -200)
    nrm = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_Normal"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_NORMAL, -900, 100)
    mask = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_EmissiveMask"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS, -900, 400)
    g.out(base, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(orm, "R", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_AMBIENT_OCCLUSION)
    g.out(orm, "G", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    g.out(orm, "B", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(nrm, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_NORMAL)
    glow = element_glow(g, -900, 650, 0.65)
    emissive = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -300, 500)
    g.connect(mask, "R", emissive, "A")
    g.connect(glow, "", emissive, "B")
    g.out(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_PistolAtlas")
    return m


def build_energy():
    # The energy bar: dark metal; cells glow (strength 7 in Blender) where ImbueU (UV channel 1) < ImbueRemaining.
    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunEnergy")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -600, -400,
                 constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.027, 0.03, 0.038, 1.0)), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -300, r=0.75), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -220, r=0.34), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -1200, 0, coordinate_index=1)
    u = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -1000, 0, r=True, g=False, b=False, a=False)
    g.connect(uv, "", u, ["", "Input"])
    remaining = g.scalar("ImbueRemaining", -1000, 120, 1.0)
    one = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -1000, 240, r=1.0)
    zero = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -1000, 320, r=0.0)
    lit = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, -800, 100)
    g.connect(u, "", lit, "A")
    g.connect(remaining, "", lit, "B")
    g.connect(zero, "", lit, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
    g.connect(zero, "", lit, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
    g.connect(one, "", lit, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])
    glow = element_glow(g, -1000, 450, 7.0)
    g.out(g.mul(lit, glow, -400, 200), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_GunEnergy")
    return m


def build_glass():
    # Sight pane: Blender mixes 13% of a dark glossy surface over full transparency.
    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunGlass")
    m.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_TRANSLUCENT)
    m.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
    m.set_editor_property("two_sided", True)
    g = Graph(m)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -600, -300,
                 constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.1, 0.13, 0.13, 1.0)), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -200, r=0.1), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    g.out(g.scalar("Opacity", -600, -100, 0.15), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_OPACITY)
    finish(m, "M_GunGlass")
    return m


def make_instance(name, parent, params):
    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
        mi = EAL.load_asset(path)
    else:
        mi = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
            name, MESH_DIR, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstant, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew())
    if mi is None:
        fail("could not create %s" % path)
    MEL.set_material_instance_parent(mi, parent)
    for p, v in params.items():
        if isinstance(v, tuple):
            MEL.set_material_instance_vector_parameter_value(mi, p, unreal.LinearColor(v[0], v[1], v[2], 1.0))
        else:
            MEL.set_material_instance_scalar_parameter_value(mi, p, v)
    MEL.update_material_instance(mi)
    return mi


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- assign and check

def assign(meshes, masters):
    instances = {}
    for blender_name, (parent_name, params) in SLOT_MATERIALS.items():
        if parent_name == SOLID:
            instances[key(blender_name)] = make_instance("MI_Pistol_" + blender_name, masters[SOLID], params)
        else:
            instances[key(blender_name)] = masters[parent_name]
    for name, mesh in meshes.items():
        slots = mesh.get_editor_property("static_materials")
        for index, slot in enumerate(slots):
            slot_key = key(str(slot.material_slot_name))
            match = next((m for k, m in instances.items() if slot_key.startswith(k)), None)
            if match is None:
                fail("%s slot %d '%s' has no material in SLOT_MATERIALS" % (name, index, slot.material_slot_name))
            mesh.set_material(index, match)
        box = mesh.get_bounding_box()
        log("mesh %s slots=%d uv_channels=%d tris=%d bounds min=(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f) max=(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f)" % (
            name, len(slots), mesh.get_num_uv_channels(0), mesh.get_num_triangles(0),
            box.min.x, box.min.y, box.min.z, box.max.x, box.max.y, box.max.z))
    if meshes["SM_Pistol_EnergyBar"].get_num_uv_channels(0) < 2:
        fail("SM_Pistol_EnergyBar lost its ImbueU UV channel")


def main():
    if not EAL.does_directory_exist(MESH_DIR):
        EAL.make_directory(MESH_DIR)
    textures = import_textures()
    meshes = import_meshes()
    masters = {SOLID: build_solid(), "M_PistolAtlas": build_atlas(textures), "M_GunEnergy": build_energy(),
               "M_GunGlass": build_glass()}
    assign(meshes, masters)
    if not EAL.save_directory(MESH_DIR, only_if_is_dirty=False, recursive=True):
        fail("could not save %s" % MESH_DIR)
    log("OK")


main()

MESHES = ["SM_Pistol_Body", "SM_Pistol_Trigger", "SM_Pistol_Magazine", "SM_Pistol_EnergyBar"]
TEXTURES = {
    # name: (compression, sRGB)
    "T_Pistol_BaseColor": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_DEFAULT, True),
    "T_Pistol_ORM": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
    "T_Pistol_Normal": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_NORMALMAP, False),
    "T_Pistol_EmissiveMask": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
}
GUN_GREEN = unreal.LinearColor(0.02, 1.0, 0.07, 1.0)

# Blender material -> (parent material, {param: value}). Values copied from the Principled BSDF of each material
# (Tools/Blender/pistol_list_materials.py). Glow = Blender emission strength (emission colour = element colour).
SOLID = "M_GunSolid"
SLOT_MATERIALS = {
    "tripo_material": ("M_PistolAtlas", {}),
    "Refinished_gunmetal_panels": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.83, 0.85, 0.88), "Metallic": 0.55, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "Refined_dark_receiver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.055, 0.061, 0.07), "Metallic": 0.78, "Roughness": 0.32}),
    "FPS_SightHousing_Black": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.027, 0.031, 0.039), "Metallic": 0.7, "Roughness": 0.36}),
    "Optic_Frame_Machined_Black": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.025, 0.03, 0.038), "Metallic": 0.7, "Roughness": 0.3}),
    "Optic_Tinted_Transparent": ("M_GunGlass", {}),
    "Optic_Reticle_Element": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.01, 0.01, 0.01), "Metallic": 0.0, "Roughness": 0.5, "Glow": 2.0}),
    "Panel_Finish_Bezel": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.012, 0.016), "Metallic": 0.75, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "Panel_Finish_Element": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.014, 0.02, 0.02), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.23, "Glow": 0.04}),
    "Panel_Finish_Graphics": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.012, 0.012), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.3, "Glow": 1.0}),
    "Trial_Magazine_DarkMetal": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.04, 0.046, 0.055), "Metallic": 0.75, "Roughness": 0.3}),
    "Trial_Magazine_Silver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.43, 0.46, 0.49), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "V4_dark_metal": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.027, 0.03, 0.038), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.35}),
    "V4_satin_edge": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.1, 0.105, 0.12), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.3}),
    "Refined_vent_recess": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.01, 0.014), "Metallic": 0.45, "Roughness": 0.42}),
    "Refined_satin_silver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.63, 0.66, 0.69), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "V4_element_emission": ("M_GunEnergy", {}),
}

MEL = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary
EAL = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary


def log(message):
    unreal.log("import_pistol: " + message)


def fail(message):
    unreal.log_error("import_pistol: ERROR " + message)
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def key(name):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower())


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- import

def run_import(filename, options=None):
    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()
    task.filename = filename
    task.destination_path = MESH_DIR
    task.automated = True
    task.replace_existing = True
    task.save = False
    if options is not None:
        task.options = options
    unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks([task])
    paths = list(task.imported_object_paths)
    if not paths:
        fail("nothing imported from %s" % filename)
    return paths


def import_textures():
    textures = {}
    for name, (compression, srgb) in TEXTURES.items():
        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Textures", name + ".png")
        if not os.path.isfile(source):
            fail("missing %s" % source)
        run_import(source)
        texture = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
        if not isinstance(texture, unreal.Texture2D):
            fail("%s did not import as a Texture2D" % name)
        texture.set_editor_property("compression_settings", compression)
        texture.set_editor_property("srgb", srgb)
        texture.set_editor_property("lod_group", unreal.TextureGroup.TEXTUREGROUP_WEAPON)
        textures[name] = texture
        log("texture %s %s srgb=%s" % (name, compression, srgb))
    return textures


def fbx_options():
    ui = unreal.FbxImportUI()
    ui.set_editor_property("import_mesh", True)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_as_skeletal", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_materials", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_textures", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_animations", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("mesh_type_to_import", unreal.FBXImportType.FBXIT_STATIC_MESH)
    data = ui.static_mesh_import_data
    data.set_editor_property("combine_meshes", True)
    data.set_editor_property("auto_generate_collision", False)
    data.set_editor_property("generate_lightmap_u_vs", False)
    data.set_editor_property("remove_degenerates", False)
    data.set_editor_property("convert_scene", True)
    data.set_editor_property("force_front_x_axis", False)
    data.set_editor_property("import_uniform_scale", 1.0)
    data.set_editor_property("normal_import_method", unreal.FBXNormalImportMethod.FBXNIM_IMPORT_NORMALS)
    return ui


def import_meshes():
    # The legacy FBX importer honours FbxImportUI; with Interchange on, these options would be translated.
    unreal.SystemLibrary.execute_console_command(None, "Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.FBX false")
    meshes = {}
    for name in MESHES:
        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Export", name + ".fbx")
        if not os.path.isfile(source):
            fail("missing %s (run Tools/Blender/pistol_export_fbx.py)" % source)
        run_import(source, fbx_options())
        mesh = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
        if not isinstance(mesh, unreal.StaticMesh):
            fail("%s did not import as a StaticMesh" % name)
        meshes[name] = mesh
    return meshes


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- materials

def get_or_create_material(name):
    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
        material = EAL.load_asset(path)
        if not isinstance(material, unreal.Material):
            fail("%s exists but is not a Material" % path)
        MEL.delete_all_material_expressions(material)
        return material
    material = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
        name, MESH_DIR, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())
    if material is None:
        fail("could not create %s" % path)
    return material


class Graph(object):
    def __init__(self, material):
        self.material = material

    def node(self, cls, x, y, **props):
        e = MEL.create_material_expression(self.material, cls, x, y)
        if e is None:
            fail("could not create %s" % cls.__name__)
        for k, v in props.items():
            e.set_editor_property(k, v)
        return e

    def connect(self, src, out, dst, inputs):
        if isinstance(inputs, str):
            inputs = [inputs]
        for i in inputs:
            if MEL.connect_material_expressions(src, out, dst, i):
                return
        fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s.%r (inputs %s)" % (
            src.get_class().get_name(), out, dst.get_class().get_name(), inputs,
            list(MEL.get_material_expression_input_names(dst))))

    def out(self, src, out, prop):
        if not MEL.connect_material_property(src, out, prop):
            fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s" % (src.get_class().get_name(), out, prop))

    def vector(self, name, x, y, value):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name,
                         default_value=unreal.LinearColor(value[0], value[1], value[2], 1.0))

    def scalar(self, name, x, y, value):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name, default_value=value)

    def mul(self, a, b, x, y):
        m = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, x, y)
        self.connect(a, "", m, "A")
        self.connect(b, "", m, "B")
        return m

    def rgb(self, src, x, y):
        m = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, x, y, r=True, g=True, b=True, a=False)
        self.connect(src, "", m, ["", "Input"])
        return m


def finish(material, name):
    errors = MEL.recompile_material(material)
    if errors:
        for e in errors:
            unreal.log_error("import_pistol: ERROR compile: %s" % e)
        fail("%s has compile errors" % name)
    bad = MEL.get_material_error_expressions(material)
    if bad:
        fail("%s: %d expressions report errors" % (name, len(bad)))
    log("material %s" % name)


def opaque(material):
    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_OPAQUE)
    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)


def element_glow(g, x, y, glow_default):
    """ElementColor * Glow -> the emissive of a part that glows in the element colour."""
    color = g.rgb(g.vector("ElementColor", x, y, (GUN_GREEN.r, GUN_GREEN.g, GUN_GREEN.b)), x + 200, y)
    return g.mul(color, g.scalar("Glow", x, y + 150, glow_default), x + 400, y + 50)


def build_solid():
    # Plain PBR values per slot (instances set them) + optional glow in the element colour.
    m = get_or_create_material(SOLID)
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    g.out(g.rgb(g.vector("BaseColor", -800, -300, (0.05, 0.05, 0.06)), -600, -300), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.scalar("Metallic", -800, -150, 0.75), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(g.scalar("Roughness", -800, -50, 0.3), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    g.out(element_glow(g, -1000, 100, 0.0), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, SOLID)
    return m


def texture_sample(g, texture, sampler, x, y):
    return g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, x, y, texture=texture, sampler_type=sampler)


def build_atlas(textures):
    # The cleaned Tripo atlas: albedo, ORM (R AO, G roughness, B metallic), DirectX normal, and the glow mask
    # (Blender: emission strength 0.65 where the mask is set, in the element colour).
    m = get_or_create_material("M_PistolAtlas")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    base = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_BaseColor"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR, -900, -500)
    orm = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_ORM"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS, -900, -200)
    nrm = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_Normal"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_NORMAL, -900, 100)
    mask = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_EmissiveMask"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS, -900, 400)
    g.out(base, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(orm, "R", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_AMBIENT_OCCLUSION)
    g.out(orm, "G", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    g.out(orm, "B", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(nrm, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_NORMAL)
    glow = element_glow(g, -900, 650, 0.65)
    emissive = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -300, 500)
    g.connect(mask, "R", emissive, "A")
    g.connect(glow, "", emissive, "B")
    g.out(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_PistolAtlas")
    return m


def build_energy():
    # The energy bar: dark metal; cells glow (strength 7 in Blender) where ImbueU (UV channel 1) < ImbueRemaining.
    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunEnergy")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -600, -400,
                 constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.027, 0.03, 0.038, 1.0)), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -300, r=0.75), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -220, r=0.34), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -1200, 0, coordinate_index=1)
    u = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -1000, 0, r=True, g=False, b=False, a=False)
    g.connect(uv, "", u, ["", "Input"])
    remaining = g.scalar("ImbueRemaining", -1000, 120, 1.0)
    one = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -1000, 240, r=1.0)
    zero = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -1000, 320, r=0.0)
    lit = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, -800, 100)
    g.connect(u, "", lit, "A")
    g.connect(remaining, "", lit, "B")
    g.connect(zero, "", lit, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
    g.connect(zero, "", lit, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
    g.connect(one, "", lit, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])
    glow = element_glow(g, -1000, 450, 7.0)
    g.out(g.mul(lit, glow, -400, 200), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_GunEnergy")
    return m


def build_glass():
    # Sight pane: Blender mixes 13% of a dark glossy surface over full transparency.
    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunGlass")
    m.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_TRANSLUCENT)
    m.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
    m.set_editor_property("two_sided", True)
    g = Graph(m)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -600, -300,
                 constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.1, 0.13, 0.13, 1.0)), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -200, r=0.1), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    g.out(g.scalar("Opacity", -600, -100, 0.15), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_OPACITY)
    finish(m, "M_GunGlass")
    return m


def make_instance(name, parent, params):
    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
        mi = EAL.load_asset(path)
    else:
        mi = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
            name, MESH_DIR, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstant, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew())
    if mi is None:
        fail("could not create %s" % path)
    MEL.set_material_instance_parent(mi, parent)
    for p, v in params.items():
        if isinstance(v, tuple):
            MEL.set_material_instance_vector_parameter_value(mi, p, unreal.LinearColor(v[0], v[1], v[2], 1.0))
        else:
            MEL.set_material_instance_scalar_parameter_value(mi, p, v)
    MEL.update_material_instance(mi)
    return mi


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- assign and check

def assign(meshes, masters):
    instances = {}
    for blender_name, (parent_name, params) in SLOT_MATERIALS.items():
        if parent_name == SOLID:
            instances[key(blender_name)] = make_instance("MI_Pistol_" + blender_name, masters[SOLID], params)
        else:
            instances[key(blender_name)] = masters[parent_name]
    for name, mesh in meshes.items():
        slots = mesh.get_editor_property("static_materials")
        for index, slot in enumerate(slots):
            slot_key = key(str(slot.material_slot_name))
            match = next((m for k, m in instances.items() if slot_key.startswith(k)), None)
            if match is None:
                fail("%s slot %d '%s' has no material in SLOT_MATERIALS" % (name, index, slot.material_slot_name))
            mesh.set_material(index, match)
        box = mesh.get_bounding_box()
        log("mesh %s slots=%d uv_channels=%d tris=%d bounds min=(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f) max=(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f)" % (
            name, len(slots), mesh.get_num_uv_channels(0), mesh.get_num_triangles(0),
            box.min.x, box.min.y, box.min.z, box.max.x, box.max.y, box.max.z))
    if meshes["SM_Pistol_EnergyBar"].get_num_uv_channels(0) < 2:
        fail("SM_Pistol_EnergyBar lost its ImbueU UV channel")


def main():
    if not EAL.does_directory_exist(MESH_DIR):
        EAL.make_directory(MESH_DIR)
    textures = import_textures()
    meshes = import_meshes()
    masters = {SOLID: build_solid(), "M_PistolAtlas": build_atlas(textures), "M_GunEnergy": build_energy(),
               "M_GunGlass": build_glass()}
    assign(meshes, masters)
    if not EAL.save_directory(MESH_DIR, only_if_is_dirty=False, recursive=True):
        fail("could not save %s" % MESH_DIR)
    log("OK")


main()

$exe = Join-Path $EngineDir 'Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'

$stamp = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')

$ok = @($ours | Where-Object { $_ -match 'import_pistol: OK' }).Count -gt 0

$ours | ForEach-Object { ($_ -replace '^\[[^\]]*\]\[[^\]]*\]', '').Trim() }
if ($errors.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host '---- errors ----'
    $errors | Select-Object -First 60 | ForEach-Object { ($_ -replace '^\[[^\]]*\]\[[^\]]*\]', '').Trim() }
}
Write-Host ("Import: ok={0} errors={1} exit={2} wall={3:N0} s  log: {4}" -f $ok, $errors.Count, $p.ExitCode, $sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, $log)
if ($ok -and $errors.Count -eq 0 -and -not $timedOut) { Write-Host 'OK'; exit 0 }
Write-Host 'FAILED'
exit 1
