1	# import_pistol.py - Unreal Editor Python script that imports the cyberpunk pistol from SourceArt and builds its
2	# materials. Content/ is not in git, so this script plus the source files on CENTRAL are the source of the assets.
3	# Run it through Tools/Jam/Import-Pistol.ps1 (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript), Editor closed.
4	#
5	# Inputs, in the temporary folder GB_PISTOL_STAGE, made from Glyphbound/SourceArt/Weapons/Pistol/Pistol.blend:
6	#   Export/SM_Pistol_{Body,Trigger,Magazine,EnergyBar}.fbx  (Tools/Blender/pistol_export_fbx.py)
7	#   Textures/T_Pistol_{BaseColor,ORM,Normal,EmissiveMask}.png (Tools/Blender/pistol_prepare_ue.py)
8	# Output: /Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol/ (meshes, textures, materials, instances). Parameters the game sets
9	# (keep in sync with AGBGun, Source/Glyphbound/Weapons/GBGun.cpp):
10	#   ElementColor   (vector) the glow colour: the enchant element, or the gun's own colour when not enchanted
11	#   ImbueRemaining (scalar) M_GunEnergy only: 0 = bar dark, 1 = full. Each of the 13 cells has one ImbueU value
12	#                  (0 at the muzzle end); a cell is lit while 1 - ImbueU < ImbueRemaining, so as the enchant runs out
13	#                  the cells go dark from the muzzle end towards the grip (left to right on screen, owner).
14	#   Flash          (scalar) M_GunIndicator only: the weak-point light, 0 = off, 1 = full glow
15	#   DisplayTexture (texture) M_GunHolo only: what the ammo display shows (white on black, the R channel glows)
16	# Every material slot of every mesh must get a material from SLOT_MATERIALS, or the script fails.
17	
18	import os
19	import re
20	import unreal
21	
22	MESH_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol"
23	# Import-Pistol.ps1 bakes the textures and exports the FBX files from Pistol.blend into a temporary folder and passes
24	# it here; the project keeps only Pistol.blend as the source and the Unreal assets as the result (owner's rule).
25	SOURCE_DIR = os.environ.get("GB_PISTOL_STAGE", "")
26	MESHES = ["SM_Pistol_Body", "SM_Pistol_Trigger", "SM_Pistol_Magazine", "SM_Pistol_EnergyBar",
27	          "SM_Pistol_WeakPointLight", "SM_Pistol_AmmoDisplay"]
28	ENERGY_CELLS = 13
29	TEXTURES = {
30	    # name: (compression, sRGB)
31	    "T_Pistol_BaseColor": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_DEFAULT, True),
32	    "T_Pistol_ORM": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
33	    "T_Pistol_Normal": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_NORMALMAP, False),
34	    "T_Pistol_EmissiveMask": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
35	}
36	GUN_GREEN = unreal.LinearColor(0.02, 1.0, 0.07, 1.0)
37	
38	# Blender material -> (parent material, {param: value}). Values copied from the Principled BSDF of each material
39	# (Tools/Blender/pistol_list_materials.py). Glow = Blender emission strength (emission colour = element colour).
40	SOLID = "M_GunSolid"
41	SLOT_MATERIALS = {
42	    "tripo_material": ("M_PistolAtlas", {}),
43	    "Refinished_gunmetal_panels": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.83, 0.85, 0.88), "Metallic": 0.55, "Roughness": 0.28}),
44	    "Refined_dark_receiver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.055, 0.061, 0.07), "Metallic": 0.78, "Roughness": 0.32}),
45	    "FPS_SightHousing_Black": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.027, 0.031, 0.039), "Metallic": 0.7, "Roughness": 0.36}),
46	    "Optic_Frame_Machined_Black": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.025, 0.03, 0.038), "Metallic": 0.7, "Roughness": 0.3}),
47	    "Optic_Tinted_Transparent": ("M_GunGlass", {}),
48	    "Optic_Reticle_Element": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.01, 0.01, 0.01), "Metallic": 0.0, "Roughness": 0.5, "Glow": 2.0}),
49	    "Panel_Finish_Bezel": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.012, 0.016), "Metallic": 0.75, "Roughness": 0.28}),
50	    "Panel_Finish_Element": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.014, 0.02, 0.02), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.23, "Glow": 0.04}),
51	    "Panel_Finish_Graphics": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.012, 0.012), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.3, "Glow": 1.0}),
52	    "Trial_Magazine_DarkMetal": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.04, 0.046, 0.055), "Metallic": 0.75, "Roughness": 0.3}),
53	    "Trial_Magazine_Silver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.43, 0.46, 0.49), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.28}),
54	    "V4_dark_metal": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.027, 0.03, 0.038), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.35}),
55	    "V4_satin_edge": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.1, 0.105, 0.12), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.3}),
56	    "Refined_vent_recess": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.01, 0.014), "Metallic": 0.45, "Roughness": 0.42}),
57	    "Refined_satin_silver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.63, 0.66, 0.69), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.28}),
58	    "V4_element_emission": ("M_GunEnergy", {}),
59	    "WeakPoint_Indicator": ("M_GunIndicator", {}),
60	    "Holo_AmmoDisplay": ("M_GunHolo", {}),
61	}
62	
63	MEL = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary
64	EAL = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary
65	
66	
67	def log(message):
68	    unreal.log("import_pistol: " + message)
69	
70	
71	def fail(message):
72	    unreal.log_error("import_pistol: ERROR " + message)
73	    raise RuntimeError(message)
74	
75	
76	def key(name):
77	    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower())
78	
79	
80	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- import
81	
82	def run_import(filename, options=None):
83	    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()
84	    task.filename = filename
85	    task.destination_path = MESH_DIR
86	    task.automated = True
87	    task.replace_existing = True
88	    task.save = False
89	    if options is not None:
90	        task.options = options
91	    unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks([task])
92	    paths = list(task.imported_object_paths)
93	    if not paths:
94	        fail("nothing imported from %s" % filename)
95	    return paths
96	
97	
98	def import_textures():
99	    textures = {}
100	    for name, (compression, srgb) in TEXTURES.items():
101	        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Textures", name + ".png")
102	        if not os.path.isfile(source):
103	            fail("missing %s" % source)
104	        run_import(source)
105	        texture = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
106	        if not isinstance(texture, unreal.Texture2D):
107	            fail("%s did not import as a Texture2D" % name)
108	        texture.set_editor_property("compression_settings", compression)
109	        texture.set_editor_property("srgb", srgb)
110	        texture.set_editor_property("lod_group", unreal.TextureGroup.TEXTUREGROUP_WEAPON)
111	        textures[name] = texture
112	        log("texture %s %s srgb=%s" % (name, compression, srgb))
113	    return textures
114	
115	
116	def fbx_options():
117	    ui = unreal.FbxImportUI()
118	    ui.set_editor_property("import_mesh", True)
119	    ui.set_editor_property("import_as_skeletal", False)
120	    ui.set_editor_property("import_materials", False)
121	    ui.set_editor_property("import_textures", False)
122	    ui.set_editor_property("import_animations", False)
123	    ui.set_editor_property("mesh_type_to_import", unreal.FBXImportType.FBXIT_STATIC_MESH)
124	    data = ui.static_mesh_import_data
125	    data.set_editor_property("combine_meshes", True)
126	    data.set_editor_property("auto_generate_collision", False)
127	    data.set_editor_property("generate_lightmap_u_vs", False)
128	    data.set_editor_property("remove_degenerates", False)
129	    data.set_editor_property("convert_scene", True)
130	    data.set_editor_property("force_front_x_axis", False)
131	    data.set_editor_property("import_uniform_scale", 1.0)
132	    data.set_editor_property("normal_import_method", unreal.FBXNormalImportMethod.FBXNIM_IMPORT_NORMALS)
133	    return ui
134	
135	
136	def import_meshes():
137	    # The legacy FBX importer honours FbxImportUI; with Interchange on, these options would be translated.
138	    unreal.SystemLibrary.execute_console_command(None, "Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.FBX false")
139	    meshes = {}
140	    for name in MESHES:
141	        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Export", name + ".fbx")
142	        if not os.path.isfile(source):
143	            fail("missing %s (run Tools/Blender/pistol_export_fbx.py)" % source)
144	        run_import(source, fbx_options())
145	        mesh = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
146	        if not isinstance(mesh, unreal.StaticMesh):
147	            fail("%s did not import as a StaticMesh" % name)
148	        meshes[name] = mesh
149	    return meshes
150	
151	
152	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- materials
153	
154	def get_or_create_material(name):
155	    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
156	    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
157	        material = EAL.load_asset(path)
158	        if not isinstance(material, unreal.Material):
159	            fail("%s exists but is not a Material" % path)
160	        MEL.delete_all_material_expressions(material)
161	        return material
162	    material = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
163	        name, MESH_DIR, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())
164	    if material is None:
165	        fail("could not create %s" % path)
166	    return material
167	
168	
169	class Graph(object):
170	    def __init__(self, material):
171	        self.material = material
172	
173	    def node(self, cls, x, y, **props):
174	        e = MEL.create_material_expression(self.material, cls, x, y)
175	        if e is None:
176	            fail("could not create %s" % cls.__name__)
177	        for k, v in props.items():
178	            e.set_editor_property(k, v)
179	        return e
180	
181	    def connect(self, src, out, dst, inputs):
182	        if isinstance(inputs, str):
183	            inputs = [inputs]
184	        for i in inputs:
185	            if MEL.connect_material_expressions(src, out, dst, i):
186	                return
187	        fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s.%r (inputs %s)" % (
188	            src.get_class().get_name(), out, dst.get_class().get_name(), inputs,
189	            list(MEL.get_material_expression_input_names(dst))))
190	
191	    def out(self, src, out, prop):
192	        if not MEL.connect_material_property(src, out, prop):
193	            fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s" % (src.get_class().get_name(), out, prop))
194	
195	    def vector(self, name, x, y, value):
196	        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name,
197	                         default_value=unreal.LinearColor(value[0], value[1], value[2], 1.0))
198	
199	    def scalar(self, name, x, y, value):
200	        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name, default_value=value)
201	
202	    def mul(self, a, b, x, y):
203	        m = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, x, y)
204	        self.connect(a, "", m, "A")
205	        self.connect(b, "", m, "B")
206	        return m
207	
208	    def rgb(self, src, x, y):
209	        m = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, x, y, r=True, g=True, b=True, a=False)
210	        self.connect(src, "", m, ["", "Input"])
211	        return m
212	
213	
214	def finish(material, name):
215	    errors = MEL.recompile_material(material)
216	    if errors:
217	        for e in errors:
218	            unreal.log_error("import_pistol: ERROR compile: %s" % e)
219	        fail("%s has compile errors" % name)
220	    bad = MEL.get_material_error_expressions(material)
221	    if bad:
222	        fail("%s: %d expressions report errors" % (name, len(bad)))
223	    log("material %s" % name)
224	
225	
226	def opaque(material):
227	    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_OPAQUE)
228	    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
229	    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)
230	
231	
232	def element_glow(g, x, y, glow_default):
233	    """ElementColor * Glow -> the emissive of a part that glows in the element colour."""
234	    color = g.rgb(g.vector("ElementColor", x, y, (GUN_GREEN.r, GUN_GREEN.g, GUN_GREEN.b)), x + 200, y)
235	    return g.mul(color, g.scalar("Glow", x, y + 150, glow_default), x + 400, y + 50)
236	
237	
238	def build_solid():
239	    # Plain PBR values per slot (instances set them) + optional glow in the element colour.
240	    m = get_or_create_material(SOLID)
241	    opaque(m)
242	    g = Graph(m)
243	    g.out(g.rgb(g.vector("BaseColor", -800, -300, (0.05, 0.05, 0.06)), -600, -300), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
244	    g.out(g.scalar("Metallic", -800, -150, 0.75), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
245	    g.out(g.scalar("Roughness", -800, -50, 0.3), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
246	    g.out(element_glow(g, -1000, 100, 0.0), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
247	    finish(m, SOLID)
248	    return m
249	
250	
251	def texture_sample(g, texture, sampler, x, y):
252	    return g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, x, y, texture=texture, sampler_type=sampler)
253	
254	
255	def build_atlas(textures):
256	    # The cleaned Tripo atlas: albedo, ORM (R AO, G roughness, B metallic), DirectX normal, and the glow mask
257	    # (Blender: emission strength 0.65 where the mask is set, in the element colour).
258	    m = get_or_create_material("M_PistolAtlas")
259	    opaque(m)
260	    g = Graph(m)
261	    base = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_BaseColor"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR, -900, -500)
262	    orm = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_ORM"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS, -900, -200)
263	    nrm = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_Normal"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_NORMAL, -900, 100)
264	    mask = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_EmissiveMask"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS, -900, 400)
265	    g.out(base, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
266	    g.out(orm, "R", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_AMBIENT_OCCLUSION)
267	    g.out(orm, "G", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
268	    g.out(orm, "B", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
269	    g.out(nrm, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_NORMAL)
270	    glow = element_glow(g, -900, 650, 0.65)
271	    emissive = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -300, 500)
272	    g.connect(mask, "R", emissive, "A")
273	    g.connect(glow, "", emissive, "B")
274	    g.out(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
275	    finish(m, "M_PistolAtlas")
276	    return m
277	
278	
279	def build_energy():
280	    # The energy bar: dark metal; cells glow (strength 7 in Blender) where ImbueU (UV channel 1) < ImbueRemaining.
281	    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunEnergy")
282	    opaque(m)
283	    g = Graph(m)
284	    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -600, -400,
285	                 constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.027, 0.03, 0.038, 1.0)), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
286	    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -300, r=0.75), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
287	    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -220, r=0.34), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
288	    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -1400, 0, coordinate_index=1)
289	    u_raw = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -1200, 0, r=True, g=False, b=False, a=False)
290	    g.connect(uv, "", u_raw, ["", "Input"])
291	    u = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionOneMinus, -1000, 0)  # the grip-end cell stays lit longest
292	    g.connect(u_raw, "", u, ["", "Input"])
293	    remaining = g.scalar("ImbueRemaining", -1000, 120, 1.0)
294	    one = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -1000, 240, r=1.0)
295	    zero = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -1000, 320, r=0.0)
296	    lit = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, -800, 100)
297	    g.connect(u, "", lit, "A")
298	    g.connect(remaining, "", lit, "B")
299	    g.connect(zero, "", lit, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
300	    g.connect(zero, "", lit, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
301	    g.connect(one, "", lit, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])
302	    glow = element_glow(g, -1000, 450, 7.0)
303	    g.out(g.mul(lit, glow, -400, 200), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
304	    finish(m, "M_GunEnergy")
305	    return m
306	
307	
308	def build_indicator():
309	    # The weak-point light next to the energy bar: dark metal like the bar, glows in the element colour with Flash.
310	    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunIndicator")
311	    opaque(m)
312	    g = Graph(m)
313	    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -600, -400,
314	                 constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.027, 0.03, 0.038, 1.0)), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
315	    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -300, r=0.75), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
316	    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -220, r=0.34), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
317	    glow = element_glow(g, -1000, 100, 10.0)
318	    g.out(g.mul(glow, g.scalar("Flash", -600, 300, 0.0), -300, 200), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
319	    finish(m, "M_GunIndicator")
320	    return m
321	
322	
323	def black_texture():
324	    for path in ["/Engine/EngineResources/Black.Black", "/Engine/EngineMaterials/BlackSquareTexture.BlackSquareTexture",
325	                 "/Engine/EngineMaterials/DefaultBlackTexture.DefaultBlackTexture"]:
326	        texture = unreal.load_asset(path)
327	        if texture is not None:
328	            return texture
329	    fail("no black engine texture found for the M_GunHolo default")
330	
331	
332	def build_holo():
333	    # Holographic ammo display: additive, unlit. The game draws the number white on black into a render target and
334	    # passes it as DisplayTexture; it glows in the element colour, with scanlines, a slow flicker and a faint tint
335	    # over the whole pane so it reads as a projected screen.
336	    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunHolo")
337	    m.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_ADDITIVE)
338	    m.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_UNLIT)
339	    m.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)
340	    g = Graph(m)
341	    texture = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSampleParameter2D, -1400, -300, parameter_name="DisplayTexture",
342	                     texture=black_texture(), sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
343	    tint = g.scalar("PaneTint", -1400, -50, 0.04)
344	    ink = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAdd, -1150, -200)
345	    g.connect(texture, "R", ink, "A")
346	    g.connect(tint, "", ink, "B")
347	    # scanlines: 0.7 + 0.3 * sin(2 pi * 48 * V)
348	    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -1600, 200, coordinate_index=0)
349	    v = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -1400, 200, r=False, g=True, b=False, a=False)
350	    g.connect(uv, "", v, ["", "Input"])
351	    lines = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -1250, 200, const_b=48.0)
352	    g.connect(v, "", lines, "A")
353	    wave = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionSine, -1100, 200, period=1.0)
354	    g.connect(lines, "", wave, ["", "Input"])
355	    scan = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -950, 200, const_b=0.3)
356	    g.connect(wave, "", scan, "A")
357	    scan_lit = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAdd, -800, 200, const_b=0.7)
358	    g.connect(scan, "", scan_lit, "A")
359	    # flicker: 0.93 + 0.07 * sin(2 pi * 7 * time)
360	    time = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTime, -1400, 400)
361	    fast = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -1250, 400, const_b=7.0)
362	    g.connect(time, "", fast, "A")
363	    flick = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionSine, -1100, 400, period=1.0)
364	    g.connect(fast, "", flick, ["", "Input"])
365	    flick_amp = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -950, 400, const_b=0.07)
366	    g.connect(flick, "", flick_amp, "A")
367	    flick_lit = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAdd, -800, 400, const_b=0.93)
368	    g.connect(flick_amp, "", flick_lit, "A")
369	    shade = g.mul(ink, g.mul(scan_lit, flick_lit, -650, 300), -500, 0)
370	    g.out(g.mul(shade, element_glow(g, -900, 600, 4.0), -300, 100), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
371	    finish(m, "M_GunHolo")
372	    return m
373	
374	
375	def build_glass():
376	    # Sight pane: Blender mixes 13% of a dark glossy surface over full transparency.
377	    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunGlass")
378	    m.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_TRANSLUCENT)
379	    m.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
380	    m.set_editor_property("two_sided", True)
381	    g = Graph(m)
382	    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -600, -300,
383	                 constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.1, 0.13, 0.13, 1.0)), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
384	    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -200, r=0.1), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
385	    g.out(g.scalar("Opacity", -600, -100, 0.15), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_OPACITY)
386	    finish(m, "M_GunGlass")
387	    return m
388	
389	
390	def make_instance(name, parent, params):
391	    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
392	    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
393	        mi = EAL.load_asset(path)
394	    else:
395	        mi = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
396	            name, MESH_DIR, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstant, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew())
397	    if mi is None:
398	        fail("could not create %s" % path)
399	    MEL.set_material_instance_parent(mi, parent)
400	    for p, v in params.items():
401	        if isinstance(v, tuple):
402	            MEL.set_material_instance_vector_parameter_value(mi, p, unreal.LinearColor(v[0], v[1], v[2], 1.0))
403	        else:
404	            MEL.set_material_instance_scalar_parameter_value(mi, p, v)
405	    MEL.update_material_instance(mi)
406	    return mi
407	
408	
409	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- assign and check
410	
411	def imbue_u_range(mesh):
412	    """Min and max U of UV channel 1 over the mesh source data (the editor UV queries are not there in a
413	    commandlet). ImbueU must span about 0..1 along the bar."""
414	    description = mesh.get_static_mesh_description(0)
415	    count = description.get_vertex_instance_count()
416	    us = []
417	    for i in range(count):
418	        vid = unreal.VertexInstanceID()
419	        vid.set_editor_property("id_value", i)
420	        us.append(round(description.get_vertex_instance_uv(vid, 1).x, 3))
421	    return min(us), max(us), count, len(set(us))
422	
423	
424	def assign(meshes, masters):
425	    instances = {}
426	    for blender_name, (parent_name, params) in SLOT_MATERIALS.items():
427	        if parent_name == SOLID:
428	            instances[key(blender_name)] = make_instance("MI_Pistol_" + blender_name, masters[SOLID], params)
429	        else:
430	            instances[key(blender_name)] = masters[parent_name]
431	    for name, mesh in meshes.items():
432	        slots = mesh.get_editor_property("static_materials")
433	        for index, slot in enumerate(slots):
434	            slot_key = key(str(slot.material_slot_name))
435	            match = next((m for k, m in instances.items() if slot_key.startswith(k)), None)
436	            if match is None:
437	                fail("%s slot %d '%s' has no material in SLOT_MATERIALS" % (name, index, slot.material_slot_name))
438	            mesh.set_material(index, match)
439	        box = mesh.get_bounding_box()
440	        log("mesh %s slots=%d tris=%d bounds min=(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f) max=(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f)" % (
441	            name, len(slots), mesh.get_num_triangles(0),
442	            box.min.x, box.min.y, box.min.z, box.max.x, box.max.y, box.max.z))
443	    u_min, u_max, count, distinct = imbue_u_range(meshes["SM_Pistol_EnergyBar"])
444	    log("energy bar ImbueU (UV 1) over %d vertex instances: %.3f .. %.3f, %d distinct values" % (
445	        count, u_min, u_max, distinct))
446	    if distinct != ENERGY_CELLS or u_min > 0.5 / ENERGY_CELLS + 0.01 or u_max < 1 - 0.5 / ENERGY_CELLS - 0.01:
447	        fail("SM_Pistol_EnergyBar UV channel 1 is not one ImbueU value per cell (expected %d)" % ENERGY_CELLS)
448	
449	
450	def main():
451	    if not SOURCE_DIR or not os.path.isdir(SOURCE_DIR):
452	        fail("GB_PISTOL_STAGE is not set or missing; run Tools/Jam/Import-Pistol.ps1")
453	    if not EAL.does_directory_exist(MESH_DIR):
454	        EAL.make_directory(MESH_DIR)
455	    textures = import_textures()
456	    meshes = import_meshes()
457	    masters = {SOLID: build_solid(), "M_PistolAtlas": build_atlas(textures), "M_GunEnergy": build_energy(),
458	               "M_GunGlass": build_glass(), "M_GunIndicator": build_indicator(), "M_GunHolo": build_holo()}
459	    assign(meshes, masters)
460	    if not EAL.save_directory(MESH_DIR, only_if_is_dirty=False, recursive=True):
461	        fail("could not save %s" % MESH_DIR)
462	    log("OK")
463	
464	
465	main()

# import_pistol.py - Unreal Editor Python script that imports the cyberpunk pistol from SourceArt and builds its
# materials. Content/ is not in git, so this script plus the source files on CENTRAL are the source of the assets.
# Run it through Tools/Jam/Import-Pistol.ps1 (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript), Editor closed.
#
# Inputs, in the temporary folder GB_PISTOL_STAGE, made from Glyphbound/SourceArt/Weapons/Pistol/Pistol.blend:
#   Export/SM_Pistol_{Body,Trigger,Magazine,EnergyBar}.fbx  (Tools/Blender/pistol_export_fbx.py)
#   Textures/T_Pistol_{BaseColor,ORM,Normal,EmissiveMask}.png (Tools/Blender/pistol_prepare_ue.py)
# Output: /Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol/ (meshes, textures, materials, instances). Parameters the game sets
# (keep in sync with AGBGun, Source/Glyphbound/Weapons/GBGun.cpp):
#   ElementColor   (vector) the glow colour: the enchant element, or the gun's own colour when not enchanted
#   ImbueRemaining (scalar) M_GunEnergy only: 0 = bar dark, 1 = full. Each of the 13 cells has one ImbueU value
#                  (0 at the muzzle end); a cell is lit while 1 - ImbueU < ImbueRemaining, so as the enchant runs out
#                  the cells go dark from the muzzle end towards the grip (left to right on screen, owner).
#   Flash          (scalar) M_GunIndicator only: the weak-point light, 0 = off, 1 = full glow
#   DisplayTexture (texture) M_GunHolo only: what the ammo display shows (white on black, the R channel glows)
# Every material slot of every mesh must get a material from SLOT_MATERIALS, or the script fails.

import os
import re
import unreal

MESH_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol"
# Import-Pistol.ps1 bakes the textures and exports the FBX files from Pistol.blend into a temporary folder and passes
# it here; the project keeps only Pistol.blend as the source and the Unreal assets as the result (owner's rule).
SOURCE_DIR = os.environ.get("GB_PISTOL_STAGE", "")
MESHES = ["SM_Pistol_Body", "SM_Pistol_Trigger", "SM_Pistol_Magazine", "SM_Pistol_EnergyBar",
          "SM_Pistol_WeakPointLight", "SM_Pistol_AmmoDisplay"]
ENERGY_CELLS = 13
TEXTURES = {
    # name: (compression, sRGB)
    "T_Pistol_BaseColor": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_DEFAULT, True),
    "T_Pistol_ORM": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
    "T_Pistol_Normal": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_NORMALMAP, False),
    "T_Pistol_EmissiveMask": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
}
GUN_GREEN = unreal.LinearColor(0.02, 1.0, 0.07, 1.0)

# Blender material -> (parent material, {param: value}). Values copied from the Principled BSDF of each material
# (Tools/Blender/pistol_list_materials.py). Glow = Blender emission strength (emission colour = element colour).
SOLID = "M_GunSolid"
SLOT_MATERIALS = {
    "tripo_material": ("M_PistolAtlas", {}),
    "Refinished_gunmetal_panels": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.83, 0.85, 0.88), "Metallic": 0.55, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "Refined_dark_receiver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.055, 0.061, 0.07), "Metallic": 0.78, "Roughness": 0.32}),
    "FPS_SightHousing_Black": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.027, 0.031, 0.039), "Metallic": 0.7, "Roughness": 0.36}),
    "Optic_Frame_Machined_Black": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.025, 0.03, 0.038), "Metallic": 0.7, "Roughness": 0.3}),
    "Optic_Tinted_Transparent": ("M_GunGlass", {}),
    "Optic_Reticle_Element": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.01, 0.01, 0.01), "Metallic": 0.0, "Roughness": 0.5, "Glow": 2.0}),
    "Panel_Finish_Bezel": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.012, 0.016), "Metallic": 0.75, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "Panel_Finish_Element": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.014, 0.02, 0.02), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.23, "Glow": 0.04}),
    "Panel_Finish_Graphics": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.012, 0.012), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.3, "Glow": 1.0}),
    "Trial_Magazine_DarkMetal": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.04, 0.046, 0.055), "Metallic": 0.75, "Roughness": 0.3}),
    "Trial_Magazine_Silver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.43, 0.46, 0.49), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "V4_dark_metal": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.027, 0.03, 0.038), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.35}),
    "V4_satin_edge": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.1, 0.105, 0.12), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.3}),
    "Refined_vent_recess": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.008, 0.01, 0.014), "Metallic": 0.45, "Roughness": 0.42}),
    "Refined_satin_silver": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.63, 0.66, 0.69), "Metallic": 0.8, "Roughness": 0.28}),
    "V4_element_emission": ("M_GunEnergy", {}),
    "WeakPoint_Indicator": ("M_GunIndicator", {}),
    "Holo_AmmoDisplay": ("M_GunHolo", {}),
}

MEL = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary
EAL = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary


def log(message):
    unreal.log("import_pistol: " + message)


def fail(message):
    unreal.log_error("import_pistol: ERROR " + message)
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def key(name):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower())


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- import

def run_import(filename, options=None):
    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()
    task.filename = filename
    task.destination_path = MESH_DIR
    task.automated = True
    task.replace_existing = True
    task.save = False
    if options is not None:
        task.options = options
    unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks([task])
    paths = list(task.imported_object_paths)
    if not paths:
        fail("nothing imported from %s" % filename)
    return paths


def import_textures():
    textures = {}
    for name, (compression, srgb) in TEXTURES.items():
        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Textures", name + ".png")
        if not os.path.isfile(source):
            fail("missing %s" % source)
        run_import(source)
        texture = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
        if not isinstance(texture, unreal.Texture2D):
            fail("%s did not import as a Texture2D" % name)
        texture.set_editor_property("compression_settings", compression)
        texture.set_editor_property("srgb", srgb)
        texture.set_editor_property("lod_group", unreal.TextureGroup.TEXTUREGROUP_WEAPON)
        textures[name] = texture
        log("texture %s %s srgb=%s" % (name, compression, srgb))
    return textures


def fbx_options():
    ui = unreal.FbxImportUI()
    ui.set_editor_property("import_mesh", True)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_as_skeletal", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_materials", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_textures", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_animations", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("mesh_type_to_import", unreal.FBXImportType.FBXIT_STATIC_MESH)
    data = ui.static_mesh_import_data
    data.set_editor_property("combine_meshes", True)
    data.set_editor_property("auto_generate_collision", False)
    data.set_editor_property("generate_lightmap_u_vs", False)
    data.set_editor_property("remove_degenerates", False)
    data.set_editor_property("convert_scene", True)
    data.set_editor_property("force_front_x_axis", False)
    data.set_editor_property("import_uniform_scale", 1.0)
    data.set_editor_property("normal_import_method", unreal.FBXNormalImportMethod.FBXNIM_IMPORT_NORMALS)
    return ui


def import_meshes():
    # The legacy FBX importer honours FbxImportUI; with Interchange on, these options would be translated.
    unreal.SystemLibrary.execute_console_command(None, "Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.FBX false")
    meshes = {}
    for name in MESHES:
        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Export", name + ".fbx")
        if not os.path.isfile(source):
            fail("missing %s (run Tools/Blender/pistol_export_fbx.py)" % source)
        run_import(source, fbx_options())
        mesh = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
        if not isinstance(mesh, unreal.StaticMesh):
            fail("%s did not import as a StaticMesh" % name)
        meshes[name] = mesh
    return meshes


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- materials

def get_or_create_material(name):
    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
        material = EAL.load_asset(path)
        if not isinstance(material, unreal.Material):
            fail("%s exists but is not a Material" % path)
        MEL.delete_all_material_expressions(material)
        return material
    material = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
        name, MESH_DIR, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())
    if material is None:
        fail("could not create %s" % path)
    return material


class Graph(object):
    def __init__(self, material):
        self.material = material

    def node(self, cls, x, y, **props):
        e = MEL.create_material_expression(self.material, cls, x, y)
        if e is None:
            fail("could not create %s" % cls.__name__)
        for k, v in props.items():
            e.set_editor_property(k, v)
        return e

    def connect(self, src, out, dst, inputs):
        if isinstance(inputs, str):
            inputs = [inputs]
        for i in inputs:
            if MEL.connect_material_expressions(src, out, dst, i):
                return
        fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s.%r (inputs %s)" % (
            src.get_class().get_name(), out, dst.get_class().get_name(), inputs,
            list(MEL.get_material_expression_input_names(dst))))

    def out(self, src, out, prop):
        if not MEL.connect_material_property(src, out, prop):
            fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s" % (src.get_class().get_name(), out, prop))

    def vector(self, name, x, y, value):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name,
                         default_value=unreal.LinearColor(value[0], value[1], value[2], 1.0))

    def scalar(self, name, x, y, value):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name, default_value=value)

    def mul(self, a, b, x, y):
        m = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, x, y)
        self.connect(a, "", m, "A")
        self.connect(b, "", m, "B")
        return m

    def rgb(self, src, x, y):
        m = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, x, y, r=True, g=True, b=True, a=False)
        self.connect(src, "", m, ["", "Input"])
        return m


def finish(material, name):
    errors = MEL.recompile_material(material)
    if errors:
        for e in errors:
            unreal.log_error("import_pistol: ERROR compile: %s" % e)
        fail("%s has compile errors" % name)
    bad = MEL.get_material_error_expressions(material)
    if bad:
        fail("%s: %d expressions report errors" % (name, len(bad)))
    log("material %s" % name)


def opaque(material):
    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_OPAQUE)
    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)


def element_glow(g, x, y, glow_default):
    """ElementColor * Glow -> the emissive of a part that glows in the element colour."""
    color = g.rgb(g.vector("ElementColor", x, y, (GUN_GREEN.r, GUN_GREEN.g, GUN_GREEN.b)), x + 200, y)
    return g.mul(color, g.scalar("Glow", x, y + 150, glow_default), x + 400, y + 50)


def build_solid():
    # Plain PBR values per slot (instances set them) + optional glow in the element colour.
    m = get_or_create_material(SOLID)
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    g.out(g.rgb(g.vector("BaseColor", -800, -300, (0.05, 0.05, 0.06)), -600, -300), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.scalar("Metallic", -800, -150, 0.75), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(g.scalar("Roughness", -800, -50, 0.3), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    g.out(element_glow(g, -1000, 100, 0.0), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, SOLID)
    return m


def texture_sample(g, texture, sampler, x, y):
    return g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, x, y, texture=texture, sampler_type=sampler)


def build_atlas(textures):
    # The cleaned Tripo atlas: albedo, ORM (R AO, G roughness, B metallic), DirectX normal, and the glow mask
    # (Blender: emission strength 0.65 where the mask is set, in the element colour).
    m = get_or_create_material("M_PistolAtlas")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    base = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_BaseColor"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR, -900, -500)
    orm = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_ORM"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS, -900, -200)
    nrm = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_Normal"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_NORMAL, -900, 100)
    mask = texture_sample(g, textures["T_Pistol_EmissiveMask"], unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS, -900, 400)
    g.out(base, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(orm, "R", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_AMBIENT_OCCLUSION)
    g.out(orm, "G", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    g.out(orm, "B", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(nrm, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_NORMAL)
    glow = element_glow(g, -900, 650, 0.65)
    emissive = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -300, 500)
    g.connect(mask, "R", emissive, "A")
    g.connect(glow, "", emissive, "B")
    g.out(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_PistolAtlas")
    return m


def build_energy():
    # The energy bar: dark metal; cells glow (strength 7 in Blender) where ImbueU (UV channel 1) < ImbueRemaining.
    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunEnergy")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -600, -400,
                 constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.027, 0.03, 0.038, 1.0)), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -300, r=0.75), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -220, r=0.34), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -1400, 0, coordinate_index=1)
    u_raw = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -1200, 0, r=True, g=False, b=False, a=False)
    g.connect(uv, "", u_raw, ["", "Input"])
    u = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionOneMinus, -1000, 0)  # the grip-end cell stays lit longest
    g.connect(u_raw, "", u, ["", "Input"])
    remaining = g.scalar("ImbueRemaining", -1000, 120, 1.0)
    one = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -1000, 240, r=1.0)
    zero = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -1000, 320, r=0.0)
    lit = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, -800, 100)
    g.connect(u, "", lit, "A")
    g.connect(remaining, "", lit, "B")
    g.connect(zero, "", lit, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
    g.connect(zero, "", lit, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
    g.connect(one, "", lit, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])
    glow = element_glow(g, -1000, 450, 7.0)
    g.out(g.mul(lit, glow, -400, 200), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_GunEnergy")
    return m


def build_indicator():
    # The weak-point light next to the energy bar: dark metal like the bar, glows in the element colour with Flash.
    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunIndicator")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -600, -400,
                 constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.027, 0.03, 0.038, 1.0)), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -300, r=0.75), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -220, r=0.34), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    glow = element_glow(g, -1000, 100, 10.0)
    g.out(g.mul(glow, g.scalar("Flash", -600, 300, 0.0), -300, 200), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_GunIndicator")
    return m


def black_texture():
    for path in ["/Engine/EngineResources/Black.Black", "/Engine/EngineMaterials/BlackSquareTexture.BlackSquareTexture",
                 "/Engine/EngineMaterials/DefaultBlackTexture.DefaultBlackTexture"]:
        texture = unreal.load_asset(path)
        if texture is not None:
            return texture
    fail("no black engine texture found for the M_GunHolo default")


def build_holo():
    # Holographic ammo display: additive, unlit. The game draws the number white on black into a render target and
    # passes it as DisplayTexture; it glows in the element colour, with scanlines, a slow flicker and a faint tint
    # over the whole pane so it reads as a projected screen.
    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunHolo")
    m.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_ADDITIVE)
    m.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_UNLIT)
    m.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)
    g = Graph(m)
    texture = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSampleParameter2D, -1400, -300, parameter_name="DisplayTexture",
                     texture=black_texture(), sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
    tint = g.scalar("PaneTint", -1400, -50, 0.04)
    ink = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAdd, -1150, -200)
    g.connect(texture, "R", ink, "A")
    g.connect(tint, "", ink, "B")
    # scanlines: 0.7 + 0.3 * sin(2 pi * 48 * V)
    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -1600, 200, coordinate_index=0)
    v = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -1400, 200, r=False, g=True, b=False, a=False)
    g.connect(uv, "", v, ["", "Input"])
    lines = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -1250, 200, const_b=48.0)
    g.connect(v, "", lines, "A")
    wave = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionSine, -1100, 200, period=1.0)
    g.connect(lines, "", wave, ["", "Input"])
    scan = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -950, 200, const_b=0.3)
    g.connect(wave, "", scan, "A")
    scan_lit = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAdd, -800, 200, const_b=0.7)
    g.connect(scan, "", scan_lit, "A")
    # flicker: 0.93 + 0.07 * sin(2 pi * 7 * time)
    time = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTime, -1400, 400)
    fast = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -1250, 400, const_b=7.0)
    g.connect(time, "", fast, "A")
    flick = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionSine, -1100, 400, period=1.0)
    g.connect(fast, "", flick, ["", "Input"])
    flick_amp = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, -950, 400, const_b=0.07)
    g.connect(flick, "", flick_amp, "A")
    flick_lit = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionAdd, -800, 400, const_b=0.93)
    g.connect(flick_amp, "", flick_lit, "A")
    shade = g.mul(ink, g.mul(scan_lit, flick_lit, -650, 300), -500, 0)
    g.out(g.mul(shade, element_glow(g, -900, 600, 4.0), -300, 100), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_GunHolo")
    return m


def build_glass():
    # Sight pane: Blender mixes 13% of a dark glossy surface over full transparency.
    m = get_or_create_material("M_GunGlass")
    m.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_TRANSLUCENT)
    m.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
    m.set_editor_property("two_sided", True)
    g = Graph(m)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -600, -300,
                 constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.1, 0.13, 0.13, 1.0)), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, -600, -200, r=0.1), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    g.out(g.scalar("Opacity", -600, -100, 0.15), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_OPACITY)
    finish(m, "M_GunGlass")
    return m


def make_instance(name, parent, params):
    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
        mi = EAL.load_asset(path)
    else:
        mi = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
            name, MESH_DIR, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstant, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew())
    if mi is None:
        fail("could not create %s" % path)
    MEL.set_material_instance_parent(mi, parent)
    for p, v in params.items():
        if isinstance(v, tuple):
            MEL.set_material_instance_vector_parameter_value(mi, p, unreal.LinearColor(v[0], v[1], v[2], 1.0))
        else:
            MEL.set_material_instance_scalar_parameter_value(mi, p, v)
    MEL.update_material_instance(mi)
    return mi


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- assign and check

def imbue_u_range(mesh):
    """Min and max U of UV channel 1 over the mesh source data (the editor UV queries are not there in a
    commandlet). ImbueU must span about 0..1 along the bar."""
    description = mesh.get_static_mesh_description(0)
    count = description.get_vertex_instance_count()
    us = []
    for i in range(count):
        vid = unreal.VertexInstanceID()
        vid.set_editor_property("id_value", i)
        us.append(round(description.get_vertex_instance_uv(vid, 1).x, 3))
    return min(us), max(us), count, len(set(us))


def assign(meshes, masters):
    instances = {}
    for blender_name, (parent_name, params) in SLOT_MATERIALS.items():
        if parent_name == SOLID:
            instances[key(blender_name)] = make_instance("MI_Pistol_" + blender_name, masters[SOLID], params)
        else:
            instances[key(blender_name)] = masters[parent_name]
    for name, mesh in meshes.items():
        slots = mesh.get_editor_property("static_materials")
        for index, slot in enumerate(slots):
            slot_key = key(str(slot.material_slot_name))
            match = next((m for k, m in instances.items() if slot_key.startswith(k)), None)
            if match is None:
                fail("%s slot %d '%s' has no material in SLOT_MATERIALS" % (name, index, slot.material_slot_name))
            mesh.set_material(index, match)
        box = mesh.get_bounding_box()
        log("mesh %s slots=%d tris=%d bounds min=(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f) max=(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f)" % (
            name, len(slots), mesh.get_num_triangles(0),
            box.min.x, box.min.y, box.min.z, box.max.x, box.max.y, box.max.z))
    u_min, u_max, count, distinct = imbue_u_range(meshes["SM_Pistol_EnergyBar"])
    log("energy bar ImbueU (UV 1) over %d vertex instances: %.3f .. %.3f, %d distinct values" % (
        count, u_min, u_max, distinct))
    if distinct != ENERGY_CELLS or u_min > 0.5 / ENERGY_CELLS + 0.01 or u_max < 1 - 0.5 / ENERGY_CELLS - 0.01:
        fail("SM_Pistol_EnergyBar UV channel 1 is not one ImbueU value per cell (expected %d)" % ENERGY_CELLS)


def main():
    if not SOURCE_DIR or not os.path.isdir(SOURCE_DIR):
        fail("GB_PISTOL_STAGE is not set or missing; run Tools/Jam/Import-Pistol.ps1")
    if not EAL.does_directory_exist(MESH_DIR):
        EAL.make_directory(MESH_DIR)
    textures = import_textures()
    meshes = import_meshes()
    masters = {SOLID: build_solid(), "M_PistolAtlas": build_atlas(textures), "M_GunEnergy": build_energy(),
               "M_GunGlass": build_glass(), "M_GunIndicator": build_indicator(), "M_GunHolo": build_holo()}
    assign(meshes, masters)
    if not EAL.save_directory(MESH_DIR, only_if_is_dirty=False, recursive=True):
        fail("could not save %s" % MESH_DIR)
    log("OK")


main()

import bpy, bmesh, sys, os, json, math
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector

argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
out_dir = argv[0]
os.makedirs(os.path.join(out_dir, "Export"), exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(out_dir, "Textures"), exist_ok=True)

    for f in bm.faces:

    info = {"tris": sum(len(p.vertices) - 2 for p in me.polygons),
            "min": [round(min(xs), 4), round(min(ys), 4), round(min(zs), 4)],

                             add_leaf_bones=False, bake_anim=False, use_custom_props=False, path_mode="STRIP",
                             axis_forward="-Z", axis_up="Y")

# ---- the magazine (new geometry) ----
MAG_HALF_W = 0.012
MAG_TOP_Z, MAG_BOTTOM_Z = -0.028, -0.163
MAG_TOP_Y = (0.014, 0.050)          # back and front faces at the top (front = smaller Y, towards the muzzle)
MAG_FORWARD = 0.03                  # how far the bottom curves towards the muzzle

def mag_section(t):

    z = MAG_TOP_Z + (MAG_BOTTOM_Z - MAG_TOP_Z) * t

    for a, b in zip(loops, loops[1:]):

            j = (i + 1) % 4
            faces.append(bm.faces.new((a[i], a[j], b[j], b[i])))

    yf, yb, z = mag_section(1.0)

                               (yf - 0.004, yb + 0.004, z - 0.007, MAG_HALF_W + 0.0015)], 1)
    # glowing round-counter slit on each side: a thin quad 0.4 mm proud of the side, from 25% to 80% of the length

            pts.append((mid - 0.003, z)); pts.append((mid + 0.003, z))

                bm.verts.new((x, pts[3][0], pts[3][1])), bm.verts.new((x, pts[2][0], pts[2][1]))]
        f = bm.faces.new(quad)
        f.material_index = 2

        for loop in f.loops:
            loop[uv].uv = (0.5, 0.5)

    """The ammo display: a 2:1 quad 2.5 mm behind the sight eyepiece's rear face (Y = 0.211, facing +Y, the player).
    UV: U to the viewer's right (-X seen from behind), V up in Blender (down in Unreal), so a texture reads upright."""
    y, x0, x1, z0, z1 = 0.2135, -0.019, 0.009, 0.121, 0.135
    uv = bm.loops.layers.uv.get("UVMap") or bm.loops.layers.uv.new("UVMap")
    vs = [bm.verts.new((x, y, z)) for x, z in [(x0, z0), (x1, z0), (x1, z1), (x0, z1)]]
    face = bm.faces.new(vs)

        face.normal_flip()
    for loop in face.loops:
        co = loop.vert.co
        loop[uv].uv = ((x1 - co.x) / (x1 - x0), (co.z - z0) / (z1 - z0))

def mat(name):
    return bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)


all_faces = set(range(len(SRC.data.polygons)))
report = {"hand_point_source": [round(v, 4) for v in HAND], "parts": {}}
for name, pivot, kwargs in [
        ("SM_Rifle_Body", HAND, {"faces": all_faces - TRIGGER_FACES - LENS_FACES, "imbue": True}),
        ("SM_Rifle_Trigger", TRIGGER_PIVOT, {"faces": TRIGGER_FACES, "imbue": True}),
        ("SM_Rifle_WeakPointLight", HAND, {"faces": LENS_FACES, "material": mat("Rifle_WeakPoint")}),
        ("SM_Rifle_AmmoDisplay", HAND, {"extra": add_display_plane, "material": mat("Holo_AmmoDisplay")}),
]:
    ob, info = build(name, pivot, **kwargs)
    report["parts"][name] = info
    export(ob)

# The magazine has three slots: body, base plate, glowing slit.
bm_mats = [mat("Rifle_Mag_Body"), mat("Rifle_Mag_Plate"), mat("Rifle_Mag_Glow")]
ob, info = build("SM_Rifle_Magazine", MAG_PIVOT, extra=add_magazine)
ob.data.materials.clear()
for m in bm_mats:
    ob.data.materials.append(m)
info["materials"] = [m.name for m in bm_mats]
report["parts"]["SM_Rifle_Magazine"] = info
export(ob)

report["magazine_out_offset"] = [round(v, 4) for v in (TURN.to_3x3() @ MAG_OUT)]
report["strip_y_source"] = [STRIP_Y0, STRIP_Y1]

# Textures: the Tripo albedo and its neon mask, as PNG.
for image_name, out_name in [(next(i.name for i in bpy.data.images if i.name.startswith("Color_")), "T_Rifle_BaseColor"),
                             ("neon_mask", "T_Rifle_EmissiveMask")]:
    im = bpy.data.images[image_name].copy()
    im.filepath_raw = os.path.join(out_dir, "Textures", out_name + ".png")
    im.file_format = "PNG"
    im.save()
    print("TEXTURE", out_name)

with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "export_report.json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
print("REPORT", json.dumps(report))

content.content:
<#
Import-Pistol.ps1 - Builds the cyberpunk pistol in Unreal from its one source file,
Glyphbound/SourceArt/Weapons/Pistol/Pistol.blend: Blender (headless) bakes the textures and exports the FBX parts to a
temporary folder, the Editor's Python commandlet (Tools/Jam/import_pistol.py) imports them into
/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol with their materials, and the temporary folder is deleted.
Content is not in git: run this on CENTRAL after Pistol.blend changes. The Editor must be closed.

Usage:
  powershell -File Tools/Jam/Import-Pistol.ps1
Output: the script's lines, the error lines of the log, OK or FAILED. Exit code 0 = imported and saved.
#>
param(
    [string]$Project = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..\Glyphbound\Glyphbound.uproject'),
    [string]$EngineDir = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.9',
    [string]$Blender = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Blender\blender.exe',
    [int]$TimeoutSeconds = 900
)
$Project = (Resolve-Path $Project).Path
$projDir = Split-Path $Project -Parent
$script = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'import_pistol.py')).Path
$exe = Join-Path $EngineDir 'Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) { Write-Host "No editor at $exe"; exit 2 }

$stamp = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')
$logDir = Join-Path $projDir 'Saved\Logs'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $logDir | Out-Null
$log = Join-Path $logDir "import_pistol_$stamp.log"

# Materials compile here, so the commandlet needs a renderer (no -NullRHI).
$argList = @("`"$Project`"", '-run=pythonscript', "-script=`"$script`"", "-abslog=`"$log`"",
    '-AllowCommandletRendering', '-unattended', '-nopause', '-nosplash', '-nosound', '-nocrashreports')

$sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()

# 1. From the one source file (Pistol.blend), bake the textures and export the FBX parts into a temporary folder.
#    The project keeps no copies of them (owner, 2026-11-12: one pistol asset, not several).
$source = Join-Path $projDir 'SourceArt\Weapons\Pistol'
$blend = Join-Path $source 'Pistol.blend'
$blenderTools = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\Blender')).Path
if (-not (Test-Path $Blender)) { Write-Host "No Blender at $Blender"; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path $blend)) { Write-Host "No source at $blend"; exit 2 }
$stage = Join-Path $projDir "Saved\PistolStage_$stamp"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $stage | Out-Null
$steps = @(@('pistol_prepare_ue.py', 'Textures', 'WROTE'), @('pistol_export_fbx.py', 'Export', 'REPORT'))
foreach ($s in $steps) {
    $out = & $Blender -b $blend --python (Join-Path $blenderTools $s[0]) -- (Join-Path $stage $s[1]) 2>&1 | Out-String
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $out -notmatch $s[2] -or $out -match 'Traceback') {
        Write-Host "Blender step $($s[0]) failed:"; Write-Host $out; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $stage; exit 1
    }
    Write-Host "Blender: $($s[0]) ok"
}
Copy-Item (Join-Path $stage 'Export\export_report.json') (Join-Path $source 'export_report.json') -Force

# 2. Import into Unreal from the temporary folder.
$env:GB_PISTOL_STAGE = $stage
$p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $argList -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
$timedOut = -not $p.WaitForExit($TimeoutSeconds * 1000)
if ($timedOut) {
    Write-Host "TIMEOUT after $TimeoutSeconds s: stopping the commandlet."
    Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
$sw.Stop()
# 3. The temporary files go away: Pistol.blend and the Unreal assets are the only copies.
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $stage

if (-not (Test-Path $log)) { Write-Host "No log at $log (exit $($p.ExitCode))"; exit 2 }

# import_rifle.py - Unreal Editor Python script that imports the assault rifle from SourceArt and builds its
# materials. Content/ is not in git, so this script plus Rifle.blend on CENTRAL are the source of the assets.
# Run it through Tools/Jam/Import-Rifle.ps1 (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript), Editor closed, pistol imported first.
#
# Inputs, in the temporary folder GB_RIFLE_STAGE (Tools/Blender/rifle_export_fbx.py):
#   Export/SM_Rifle_{Body,Trigger,Magazine,WeakPointLight,AmmoDisplay}.fbx
#   Textures/T_Rifle_{BaseColor,EmissiveMask}.png
# Output: /Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Rifle/. Parameters the game sets (same names as the pistol, AGBGun):
#   ElementColor   (vector) the glow colour (enchant element, or the rifle's own colour)
#   ImbueRemaining (scalar) M_RifleAtlas: the side neon strip is split into 13 cells along the gun (UV 1 U = 0 at the
#                  strip's muzzle end); a cell is lit while 1 - its centre U < ImbueRemaining, so the strip drains from
#                  the muzzle end towards the stock, like the pistol bar. Glow off the strip (UV 1 V = 1) stays lit.
#   Flash          (scalar) M_RifleIndicator: the two sight lenses, 0 = off, 1 = full glow (weak-point hit)
#   DisplayTexture (texture) M_GunHolo (shared with the pistol): the ammo count
import os
import re
import unreal

MESH_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Rifle"
SHARED_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol"   # M_GunSolid and M_GunHolo, built by import_pistol.py
SOURCE_DIR = os.environ.get("GB_RIFLE_STAGE", "")
MESHES = ["SM_Rifle_Body", "SM_Rifle_Trigger", "SM_Rifle_Magazine", "SM_Rifle_WeakPointLight", "SM_Rifle_AmmoDisplay"]
STRIP_CELLS = 13
CELL_GAP = 0.12          # dark share at the start of each cell, so the strip reads as segments
STRIP_GLOW = 4.0         # emission strength of the neon in the element colour
INDICATOR_GLOW = 10.0
TEXTURES = {
    # name: (compression, sRGB)
    "T_Rifle_BaseColor": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_DEFAULT, True),
    "T_Rifle_EmissiveMask": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
}
MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE = 2048   # the Tripo maps are 4096; half is plenty for a viewmodel and keeps the package small
RIFLE_MINT = (0.05, 0.9, 0.6)

SOLID = "M_GunSolid"
SLOT_MATERIALS = {
    "carabina_roja": ("M_RifleAtlas", {}),
    "Rifle_WeakPoint": ("M_RifleIndicator", {}),
    "Holo_AmmoDisplay": ("M_GunHolo", {}),
    "Rifle_Mag_Body": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.035, 0.04, 0.045), "Metallic": 0.6, "Roughness": 0.35}),
    "Rifle_Mag_Plate": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.72, 0.74, 0.77), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.45}),
    "Rifle_Mag_Glow": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.01, 0.01, 0.01), "Metallic": 0.0, "Roughness": 0.5, "Glow": 4.0}),
}

MEL = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary
EAL = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary


def log(message):
    unreal.log("import_rifle: " + message)


def fail(message):
    unreal.log_error("import_rifle: ERROR " + message)
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def key(name):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower())


def run_import(filename, options=None):
    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()
    task.filename = filename
    task.destination_path = MESH_DIR
    task.automated = True
    task.replace_existing = True
    task.save = False
    if options is not None:
        task.options = options
    unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks([task])
    paths = list(task.imported_object_paths)
    if not paths:
        fail("nothing imported from %s" % filename)
    return paths


def import_textures():
    textures = {}
    for name, (compression, srgb) in TEXTURES.items():
        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Textures", name + ".png")
        if not os.path.isfile(source):
            fail("missing %s" % source)
        run_import(source)
        texture = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
        if not isinstance(texture, unreal.Texture2D):
            fail("%s did not import as a Texture2D" % name)
        texture.set_editor_property("compression_settings", compression)
        texture.set_editor_property("srgb", srgb)
        texture.set_editor_property("lod_group", unreal.TextureGroup.TEXTUREGROUP_WEAPON)
        texture.set_editor_property("max_texture_size", MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE)
        textures[name] = texture
        log("texture %s %s srgb=%s max=%d" % (name, compression, srgb, MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE))
    return textures


def fbx_options():
    ui = unreal.FbxImportUI()
    ui.set_editor_property("import_mesh", True)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_as_skeletal", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_materials", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_textures", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_animations", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("mesh_type_to_import", unreal.FBXImportType.FBXIT_STATIC_MESH)
    data = ui.static_mesh_import_data
    data.set_editor_property("combine_meshes", True)
    data.set_editor_property("auto_generate_collision", False)
    data.set_editor_property("generate_lightmap_u_vs", False)
    data.set_editor_property("remove_degenerates", False)
    data.set_editor_property("convert_scene", True)
    data.set_editor_property("force_front_x_axis", False)
    data.set_editor_property("import_uniform_scale", 1.0)
    data.set_editor_property("normal_import_method", unreal.FBXNormalImportMethod.FBXNIM_IMPORT_NORMALS)
    return ui


def import_meshes():
    unreal.SystemLibrary.execute_console_command(None, "Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.FBX false")
    meshes = {}
    for name in MESHES:
        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Export", name + ".fbx")
        if not os.path.isfile(source):
            fail("missing %s (run Tools/Blender/rifle_export_fbx.py)" % source)
        run_import(source, fbx_options())
        mesh = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
        if not isinstance(mesh, unreal.StaticMesh):
            fail("%s did not import as a StaticMesh" % name)
        meshes[name] = mesh
    return meshes


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- materials

def get_or_create_material(name):
    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
        material = EAL.load_asset(path)
        if not isinstance(material, unreal.Material):
            fail("%s exists but is not a Material" % path)
        MEL.delete_all_material_expressions(material)
        return material
    material = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
        name, MESH_DIR, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())
    if material is None:
        fail("could not create %s" % path)
    return material


class Graph(object):
    def __init__(self, material):
        self.material = material

    def node(self, cls, x, y, **props):
        e = MEL.create_material_expression(self.material, cls, x, y)
        if e is None:
            fail("could not create %s" % cls.__name__)
        for k, v in props.items():
            e.set_editor_property(k, v)
        return e

    def connect(self, src, out, dst, inputs):
        if isinstance(inputs, str):
            inputs = [inputs]
        for i in inputs:
            if MEL.connect_material_expressions(src, out, dst, i):
                return
        fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s.%r (inputs %s)" % (
            src.get_class().get_name(), out, dst.get_class().get_name(), inputs,
            list(MEL.get_material_expression_input_names(dst))))

    def out(self, src, out, prop):
        if not MEL.connect_material_property(src, out, prop):
            fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s" % (src.get_class().get_name(), out, prop))

    def scalar(self, name, x, y, value):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name, default_value=value)

    def const(self, value, x, y):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, x, y, r=value)

    def binary(self, cls, a, b, x, y, a_out="", b_out=""):
        m = self.node(cls, x, y)
        self.connect(a, a_out, m, "A")
        self.connect(b, b_out, m, "B")
        return m

    def mul(self, a, b, x, y, a_out="", b_out=""):
        return self.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, a, b, x, y, a_out, b_out)

    def unary(self, cls, src, x, y, src_out=""):
        m = self.node(cls, x, y)
        self.connect(src, src_out, m, ["", "Input"])
        return m

    def less(self, a, b, x, y):
        """1 where a < b, else 0."""
        e = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, x, y)
        self.connect(a, "", e, "A")
        self.connect(b, "", e, "B")
        zero, one = self.const(0.0, x - 150, y + 120), self.const(1.0, x - 150, y + 200)
        self.connect(zero, "", e, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
        self.connect(zero, "", e, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
        self.connect(one, "", e, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])
        return e


def finish(material, name):
    errors = MEL.recompile_material(material)
    if errors:
        for e in errors:
            unreal.log_error("import_rifle: ERROR compile: %s" % e)
        fail("%s has compile errors" % name)
    bad = MEL.get_material_error_expressions(material)
    if bad:
        fail("%s: %d expressions report errors" % (name, len(bad)))
    log("material %s" % name)


def opaque(material):
    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_OPAQUE)
    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)


def surface(g, textures):
    """Albedo from the Tripo map; white polymer roughness and metallic (the source has no ORM). Returns the mask."""
    base = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, -1400, -600, texture=textures["T_Rifle_BaseColor"],
                  sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
    g.out(base, "RGB", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    g.out(g.const(0.15, -600, -450), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    g.out(g.const(0.42, -600, -380), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    return g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, -1400, -300, texture=textures["T_Rifle_EmissiveMask"],
                  sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS)


def element_color(g, x, y):
    v = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, x, y, parameter_name="ElementColor",
               default_value=unreal.LinearColor(RIFLE_MINT[0], RIFLE_MINT[1], RIFLE_MINT[2], 1.0))
    return g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, x + 200, y, r=True, g=True, b=True, a=False) \
        if False else _rgb(g, v, x + 200, y)


def _rgb(g, src, x, y):
    m = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, x, y, r=True, g=True, b=True, a=False)
    g.connect(src, "", m, ["", "Input"])
    return m


def build_atlas(textures):
    m = get_or_create_material("M_RifleAtlas")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    mask = surface(g, textures)
    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -2200, 200, coordinate_index=1)
    u = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionSaturate,
                g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -2000, 200, r=True, g=False, b=False, a=False), -1650, 200)
    g.connect(uv, "", g.material and MEL.get_inputs_for_material_expression(m, u)[0] if False else u, ["", "Input"]) \
        if False else None
    # (wired below: uv -> mask R -> saturate)
    u_mask = MEL.get_inputs_for_material_expression(m, u)[0] if False else None
    return m, g, mask, uv, u


def build_atlas_full(textures):
    # Body: albedo, neon mask in the element colour; on the strip (UV 1 V = 0) only lit cells glow, with thin gaps.
    m = get_or_create_material("M_RifleAtlas")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    mask = surface(g, textures)
    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -2400, 200, coordinate_index=1)
    u_raw = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -2200, 200, r=True, g=False, b=False, a=False)
    g.connect(uv, "", u_raw, ["", "Input"])
    off_strip = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -2200, 500, r=False, g=True, b=False, a=False)
    g.connect(uv, "", off_strip, ["", "Input"])
    u = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionSaturate, u_raw, -2000, 200)
    scaled = g.mul(u, g.const(float(STRIP_CELLS) * 0.99999, -2000, 320), -1850, 200)
    cell = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionFloor, scaled, -1700, 150)
    centre = g.mul(g.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionAdd, cell, g.const(0.5, -1700, 260), -1550, 150),
                   g.const(1.0 / STRIP_CELLS, -1550, 260), -1400, 150)
    from_muzzle = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionOneMinus, centre, -1250, 150)
    lit = g.less(from_muzzle, g.scalar("ImbueRemaining", -1250, 260, 1.0), -1050, 150)
    within = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionFrac, scaled, -1700, 380)
    not_gap = g.less(g.const(CELL_GAP, -1550, 480), within, -1400, 380)
    strip_on = g.mul(lit, not_gap, -850, 250)
    on = g.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionMax, strip_on, off_strip, -650, 300)
    glow = g.mul(element_color(g, -1200, 700), g.scalar("Glow", -1000, 820, STRIP_GLOW), -800, 700)
    emissive = g.mul(g.mul(mask, on, -500, 400, a_out="R"), glow, -300, 500)
    g.out(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_RifleAtlas")
    return m


def build_indicator(textures):
    # The two sight lenses: same surface as the body; the neon mask glows only with Flash (weak-point hit).
    m = get_or_create_material("M_RifleIndicator")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    mask = surface(g, textures)

#   Export/SM_Rifle_{Body,Trigger,Magazine,WeakPointLight,AmmoDisplay}.fbx
#   Textures/T_Rifle_{BaseColor,EmissiveMask}.png
# Output: /Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Rifle/. Parameters the game sets (same names as the pistol, AGBGun):
#   ElementColor   (vector) the glow colour (enchant element, or the rifle's own colour)
#   ImbueRemaining (scalar) M_RifleAtlas: the side neon strip is split into 13 cells along the gun (UV 1 U = 0 at the
#                  strip's muzzle end); a cell is lit while 1 - its centre U < ImbueRemaining, so the strip drains from
#                  the muzzle end towards the stock, like the pistol bar. Glow off the strip (UV 1 V = 1) stays lit.
#   Flash          (scalar) M_RifleIndicator: the two sight lenses, 0 = off, 1 = full glow (weak-point hit)
#   DisplayTexture (texture) M_GunHolo (shared with the pistol): the ammo count
import os
import re
import unreal

SHARED_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol"   # M_GunSolid and M_GunHolo, built by import_pistol.py
SOURCE_DIR = os.environ.get("GB_RIFLE_STAGE", "")
MESHES = ["SM_Rifle_Body", "SM_Rifle_Trigger", "SM_Rifle_Magazine", "SM_Rifle_WeakPointLight", "SM_Rifle_AmmoDisplay"]
STRIP_CELLS = 13
CELL_GAP = 0.12          # dark share at the start of each cell, so the strip reads as segments
STRIP_GLOW = 4.0         # emission strength of the neon in the element colour
INDICATOR_GLOW = 10.0
TEXTURES = {
    # name: (compression, sRGB)
    "T_Rifle_BaseColor": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_DEFAULT, True),
    "T_Rifle_EmissiveMask": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
}
MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE = 2048   # the Tripo maps are 4096; half is plenty for a viewmodel and keeps the package small
RIFLE_MINT = (0.05, 0.9, 0.6)

SOLID = "M_GunSolid"
SLOT_MATERIALS = {
    "carabina_roja": ("M_RifleAtlas", {}),
    "Rifle_WeakPoint": ("M_RifleIndicator", {}),
    "Holo_AmmoDisplay": ("M_GunHolo", {}),
    "Rifle_Mag_Body": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.035, 0.04, 0.045), "Metallic": 0.6, "Roughness": 0.35}),
    "Rifle_Mag_Plate": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.72, 0.74, 0.77), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.45}),
    "Rifle_Mag_Glow": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.01, 0.01, 0.01), "Metallic": 0.0, "Roughness": 0.5, "Glow": 4.0}),
}

def log(message):

    task.replace_existing = True
    task.save = False
    if options is not None:
        task.options = options

    paths = list(task.imported_object_paths)
    if not paths:
        fail("nothing imported from %s" % filename)

    textures = {}

            fail("missing %s" % source)

            fail("%s did not import as a Texture2D" % name)

        texture.set_editor_property("srgb", srgb)
        texture.set_editor_property("lod_group", unreal.TextureGroup.TEXTUREGROUP_WEAPON)
        texture.set_editor_property("max_texture_size", MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE)

    ui.set_editor_property("import_animations", False)

            fail("could not create %s" % cls.__name__)

        if isinstance(inputs, str):
            inputs = [inputs]
        for i in inputs:
            if MEL.connect_material_expressions(src, out, dst, i):
                return

            src.get_class().get_name(), out, dst.get_class().get_name(), inputs,
            list(MEL.get_material_expression_input_names(dst))))

    def out(self, src, out, prop):
        if not MEL.connect_material_property(src, out, prop):
            fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s" % (src.get_class().get_name(), out, prop))

    def scalar(self, name, x, y, value):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name, default_value=value)

    def const(self, value, x, y):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, x, y, r=value)

    def binary(self, cls, a, b, x, y, a_out="", b_out=""):
        m = self.node(cls, x, y)
        self.connect(a, a_out, m, "A")
        self.connect(b, b_out, m, "B")
        return m

    def mul(self, a, b, x, y, a_out="", b_out=""):
        return self.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, a, b, x, y, a_out, b_out)

        m = self.node(cls, x, y)

        return m

        e = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, x, y)
        self.connect(a, "", e, "A")
        self.connect(b, "", e, "B")
        zero, one = self.const(0.0, x - 150, y + 120), self.const(1.0, x - 150, y + 200)
